  • Engage and build relationships with procurement, finance, and transformation leaders

  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads, and re-engage dormant opportunities

We are seeking for a proactive, detail-oriented Lead Generation Specialist.

This in-house role will be responsible for identifying, researching, and engaging decision-makers in the healthcare industry to support our sales and marketing goals.

The ideal candidate has experience in email outreach, understands hospital industry dynamics, and is capable of creating and executing campaigns that align with our brand voice while building trust and opening conversations with qualified prospects.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify and build lists of verified hospital contacts based on our target audience (specific roles, titles, and regions).
  • Conduct manual research to validate contact information and relevance.
  • Develop tailored outreach messaging based on pain points and campaign objectives.
  • Execute email campaigns using platforms like SendGrid (aligned with Odoo).
  • Monitor, manage, and respond to lead replies to nurture them through the pipeline.
  • Maintain a consistent tone and messaging aligned with the company's brand.
  • Track campaign performance and report on lead quality, objections, and interest.
  • Collaborate with sales and marketing to refine messaging and target segments.
  • Ensure compliance with email marketing best practices to avoid blacklisting, especially with healthcare servers.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in lead generation, sales development, or email outreach (healthcare industry preferred).
  • Strong research skills and attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with tools like SendGrid, Odoo (or similar CRM)
  • Clear, persuasive communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.
  • Comfortable handling large data lists and segmenting based on target criteria.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience generating leads within hospitals or the healthcare industry.
  • Experience integrating CRM data for outreach and reporting.

System Requirements:

  • Computer Memory/RAM: Minimum 4.00 GB
  • Computer Operating System: Windows 10 or Mac OSX - No Linux, Unix, or any operating system other than what is required.
  • Internet Speed: Running on a 5.0 MBPS plan or higher (Both primary and backup) - If your backup connection cannot serve as your primary connection, that does not qualify as a backup connection
  • REQUIRED Headset: Noise-cancelling headset connected via USB port

If you have an "I CAN" and "I WILL" mindset, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today!

Click APPLY NOW and be one step closer to:

We’d like to make this application easier for you!

Let’s skip the lengthy pre-qualification questions – Just tell us about yourself and answer a few key questions through a short video, making the application faster, easier and more personal.

WITHOUT reading from a script, please do the following and answer all these questions:

  1. Please introduce yourself and tell us where you are currently located.
  2. Briefly summarize your most relevant work experience in lead generation.
  3. Why are you interested in this position and why do you believe you would be a good fit?

INSTRUCTIONS:

  • Audio should be clear.
  • Applicant should record from the environment where they normally expect to work, when possible.

Join a dynamic team at the pulse of global markets, where we deliver innovative software and service solutions for essential financial reporting and capital markets transactions. At DFIN, we are a values-driven organization that empowers you to build a fulfilling career while bringing your authentic self to work every day. Our “Win as One” mentality ensures that our team’s success is directly linked to Client, Shareholder and Employee Satisfaction.

In 2026, DFIN was named #1 on the 2026 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces® by Best Practice Institute. We have also been recognized as one of America’s Most Loved Workplaces® for five consecutive years and a Built In Best Place to Work for six years, reflecting our continued commitment to supporting employees’ total well-being. Enjoy competitive compensation, a flexible workplace, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for professional growth. Bring your passion and talents to DFIN – because being YOU thrives here.

Summary:

The Business Performance & Analytics Senior contributes to reporting, analytics, and performance management initiatives by developing dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical solutions that provide meaningful business insights and performance visibility.

This role partners with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to understand reporting needs, deliver reporting and analytical solutions, and contribute to accurate, reliable, and actionable performance reporting. The Senior is expected to work independently within assigned areas while also partnering with Business Performance & Analytics Principals and other team members on larger initiatives and more complex workstreams.

The role requires a balance of reporting development, data analysis, problem-solving, stakeholder partnership, attention to detail, and continuous learning.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, scorecards, and reporting solutions that support operational and business priorities.
  • Develop and maintain KPI reporting, performance measurement, and scorecard solutions across functional areas.
  • Perform trend analysis, root-cause analysis, and data investigations to identify patterns, risks, and opportunities.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements, clarify reporting needs, and deliver reporting and analytical solutions.
  • Validate data, reconcile reporting outputs, and perform quality reviews to ensure reporting accuracy and consistency.
  • Contribute to reporting modernization, automation, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Perform and contribute to forecasting, workload analysis, and performance reporting activities.
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives and project work requiring reporting, measurement, and analytical expertise.
  • Document reporting logic, KPI definitions, data sources, and reporting methodologies.
  • Apply established reporting standards, governance practices, and data quality controls.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, reporting efficiency, and data usability.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Operations, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • 3–5+ years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, operational reporting, performance management, or analytics-enabled business support.
  • Experience developing dashboards, reports, scorecards, or business intelligence solutions.
  • Strong Power BI experience, including report development, data modeling, measures, visualizations, and dashboard maintenance.
  • Strong SQL skills with the ability to extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.

· Strong Excel and analytical skills.

  • Experience working with operational, financial, client, quality, productivity, or performance-related metrics.
  • Experience gathering requirements and partnering with business stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate findings and insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to reporting accuracy and data quality.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.

Relevant Experience

  • KPI reporting, scorecards, performance measurement, or reporting governance.
  • Trend analysis, root-cause analysis, forecasting, or performance analytics.
  • Reporting modernization, process improvement, automation, or workflow optimization initiatives.
  • Operations, service delivery, manufacturing, supply chain, financial operations, or other execution-focused environments.
  • Data validation, reconciliation, quality assurance, or controls-based reporting.
  • Power Query, DAX, data modeling, or advanced reporting techniques.
  • AI-enabled analytics, automation tools, Copilot capabilities, or emerging analytics technologies.
  • Data visualization and storytelling techniques that improve decision-making and business understanding.

Core Competencies

  • Reporting and Dashboard Development: Develops reporting solutions that provide clear, accurate, and actionable business insights.
  • Data Analysis: Performs analysis to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and performance drivers.
  • Problem Solving: Applies analytical thinking to investigate issues and support decision-making.
  • Business Partnership: Works with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver meaningful reporting solutions.
  • Data Quality and Validation: Ensures data accuracy, consistency, and reliability through validation and quality review processes.
  • Performance Measurement: Supports KPI reporting, scorecards, and operational performance visibility.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identifies opportunities to improve reporting processes, usability, efficiency, and effectiveness.

The salary range for this role is $2,800 - $6,800 USD gross per month (Based on experience and performance during the interview process)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

Sezzle is currently seeking a Data Analyst to help drive business outcomes through analytics. This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while partnering with stakeholders across the organization to identify opportunities, measure performance, and improve operational efficiency.

You will collaborate with teams across Product, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Support, Legal, and People Operations to define key metrics, build reporting solutions, and deliver actionable analysis. Responsibilities include writing SQL queries, developing dashboards, performing exploratory analyses, and contributing Python-based analytics workflows that support scalable decision-making across the business.

What You'll Do:

  • Work closely with business teams to understand their priorities and analytics needs
  • Create sophisticated analyses and reporting to provide insights at scale that support strategic initiatives and empower data-informed decision-making
  • Visualize and articulate analytics results to make it easy for stakeholders to interpret and take actions
  • Help stakeholders identify new opportunities through data analysis
  • Create, monitor, review, and analyze reports and dashboards, take initiative to fix issues that arise and conduct root cause analyses
  • Utilize modern AI tools, including LLMs, copilots, and workflow automation platforms, to enhance analytical productivity and develop scalable solutions to business problems

What We Look for:

  • Degree in statistics, math, actuarial science, economics, data science, computer science or related quantitative discipline
  • Master’s degree or 3+ years of professional experience working with data, which can include: complex dataset creation, reporting, profiling, and machine learning
  • Expert in using SQL to extract data and create actionable data sets
  • Experience with Python for data processing and analytics
  • Ability to complete analyses with minimal guidance
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Redash, Tableau, Looker or Power BI
  • Comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment, able to pivot quickly to new priorities
  • Excellent problem-solving skills
  • Strong business judgment and communication skills
  • Fluent in English

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline
  • Experience optimizing operational and financial performance
  • Experience in payments, financial services, banking, fintech, BNPL

The Tech You’ll Work With:

  • Python
  • Redshift, PostgreSQL
  • Data build tool (dbt)
  • AWS, G Suite, Mac
  • Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT

Interview Process:

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Verbal case study interview. Share how you approach new problems. A “How would you…” conversation.
  • Verbal behavioral interview. Share your problem-solving experience. A “Tell me about a time when you…” conversation.
  • Offer!

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

raw.description:
At Team Carney, we believe that true performance acceleration happens at the intersection of innovative learning and deep strategic expertise. Since 1994, our mission has been to provide top-tier training, learning, and human capital solutions that empower Federal Government agencies to meet their critical mandates. We are seeking a detail-oriented, high-performing Trusted Tester - Level I (Web Tester) to support our federal client.

This position is contingent on contract award.

Work Schedule and Location

  • Employment Status: Part-Time (~30 hours per week)

  • Location: This position is fully remote, based out of Fredericksburg, VA.

Who You Are & What You’ll Do

The Trusted Tester - Level I (Web Tester) will be responsible for evaluating, testing, and validating Section 508 compliance across a wide array of Information and Communications Technology (ICT) deliverables, web-based applications, and digital learning products.

You will utilize the current Department of Homeland Security (DHS) approved assessment methods, test reporting tools, and conformance processes to ensure all digital assets meet Revised Section 508 Standards. You will conduct rigorous web accessibility evaluations, document technical non-conformance defects, and collaborate closely with development and instructional design teams to deliver fully accessible, compliant, and inclusive user experiences.

What You Bring to the Table - Requirements

  • Certification: Active DHS Trusted Tester Version 5.0 (or later) Certification required.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.

  • Technical Experience:

    • 2+ years of experience working with Information and Communications Technology (ICT) environments.

    • 1+ year of dedicated Section 508 accessibility testing experience.

  • Assessment Methodology: Demonstrated experience using the DHS Trusted Tester Version Section 508 Conformance Test Process for Web (v5.0 or later) and official DHS test reporting tools and formats.

  • Core Capabilities:

    • Section 508 Standards Knowledge: Solid working knowledge of the Revised Section 508 Standards and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

    • Web Conformance Testing: Expertise executing standardized manual and automated web accessibility test scripts across various browsers and ICT interfaces.

    • Defect Identification & Reporting: Ability to accurately document compliance failures, generate standardized test reports, and provide clear remediation guidance.

    • Collaboration: Strong communication skills to liaise with project managers, developers, and content creators to integrate accessibility best practices early in the product lifecycle.

Why Join Team Carney?

When you join Team Carney, you join a legacy of excellence. We focus on our people because when we make a positive impact on the lives of our employees, they are able to make a positive impact on our clients. We offer a full suite of competitive benefits, including:

  • Health & Wellness: Multiple medical, dental, and vision insurance options (BCBS CareFirst), health spending accounts (HSA), and flexible spending accounts (FSA).

  • Financial Security: 401(k) retirement plan with company match, plus Carney-paid life and disability insurance.

  • Work-Life Harmony: Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), 11 paid holidays, and 6 weeks of paid parental leave.

  • Professional & Personal Growth: Annual tuition assistance (up to $5,000) and student loan repayment.

  • Get Out and Learn: Up to $200 annually to learn almost anything (from pottery to coding!).

  • Get Out and Run: Up to $200 annually to participate in fitness and active lifestyle events.

  • Continuous Development: Ad hoc training and ongoing professional development access.

raw.excerpt: Code and Theory is a digital-first creative and technology agency that builds products, platforms and experiences for global brands.
raw.description:
Code and Theory is a digital-first creative and technology agency that builds products, platforms and experiences for global brands. We combine engineering, design, data and strategy to deliver transformative digital solutions at scale.

This role leads the GTM pillar of the Adobe practice. Roughly 50% pursuits and solutioning, 25% Adobe alliance and account growth, 15% building offerings and accelerators, 10% leading a team. That will tilt heavily toward pursuits in quarters where the pipeline is hot.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead technical solutioning on enterprise pursuits: architecture narrative, effort estimation, staffing shape, scope definition and pricing input
  • Own the pitch, build the story, stand in front of client executives alongside creative and strategy leads, and defend the approach under pressure
  • Decide what to chase and what to decline, and make the case for walking away when the work isn't right
  • Produce estimates that hold up and own estimate-versus-actual accuracy as a practice discipline
  • Be the commercial and technical face of Code and Theory inside Adobe: field teams, product, partner organization
  • Drive the co-sell motion, build named relationships, generate referral flow, and position us on deals before they reach RFP
  • Support Adobe's own sales motion, including forward-deployed architects who run proofs of concept and value-realization work at Adobe's clients
  • Know when to recommend against Adobe's preferred product because it's wrong for the client and hold that line
  • Expand existing engagements through consulting-led growth rather than staffing volume
  • Convert implementation projects into multi-year retained relationships, including structuring commercial models that let clients flex without renegotiating
  • Build an independent client base rather than depending on referred work
  • Create productized offerings, accelerators, reference architectures and demo assets the practice can reuse and sell
  • Establish the pursuit process: qualification, solutioning, review, handoff, and make it repeatable across a growing team
  • Own the clean handoff into delivery, and stay accountable after signature when scope or expectations need renegotiating
  • Hire, lead and grow a team of solution architects and pre-sales specialists across the US
  • Own performance management, development and compensation for that team
  • Establish AI-native working across the pursuit motion using Claude, Cursor and equivalent tooling to accelerate RFP response, solution documentation, estimation and demo building, and building agentic tooling where it earns its place

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 15+ years in technology, including 5+ years owning a revenue or pipeline number
  • Demonstrable growth you personally drove: portfolio value, win rate, average deal size, account expansion
  • Experience owning or heavily influencing pursuits at $1M+, and comfort operating at $10M+ program scale
  • A track record of commitments that held
  • Deep working knowledge of Adobe Experience Cloud - AEM, EDS, AEP, RTCDP, Workfront, Fusion, Analytics, Target, AJO - sufficient to shape a solution and hold a client architecture conversation
  • Enough command across content, data and work management to know which products fit a problem and which don't
  • Genuine experience of the Adobe partner motion: co-sell, alliance management, field relationships
  • Experience owning end-to-end RFP responses: strategy, entity assembly, narrative coherence, and delivering the pitch
  • Executive stakeholder management, including C-suite advisory and difficult conversations about scope, timeline or price
  • Experience with US and EU enterprise clients; APAC useful
  • Direct management of a client-facing team, including performance reviews and compensation decisions
  • Experience working with offshore and nearshore delivery - India, LATAM, Philippines - and making that partnership work in practice rather than nominally
  • Agency or consultancy background; understanding of billability, utilization and margin, and why an inaccurate estimate is a commercial failure
  • Hands-on daily use of AI tooling: RFP response, solution documentation, estimation, demo development
  • Experience building or directing agentic tooling, not only consuming AI features
  • Ability to establish AI-native practice across a team, including with people who are skeptical

NICE TO HAVE

  • Prior time inside Adobe, or extensive partner-side work deploying Adobe services
  • Experience building a practice or offering portfolio from an early stage
  • Adobe certifications across multiple products
  • Experience selling into agency networks or holding-company structures
  • Published thought leadership, or an active presence in the Adobe ecosystem

ABOUT US

Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic.

Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel & hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J.P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok.

The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2,000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We’re always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward-thinking people to join our team.

The compensation range for this role is $225,000 - $300,000 and spans multiple levels. We're open to hiring at the level that best matches the right candidate's experience. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, budget, and location.

raw.description:
Overview

The Project Manager role is responsible for high level management, delegation, and execution of day-to-day e-discovery project tasks, reporting to the PM Project Director team. The role involves concurrently managing multiple projects of varying complexity. The Project Manager will collaborate with attorneys, paralegals, IT personnel, and other members of the counsel and/or client legal team to ensure the successful completion of e-discovery matters. Project Managers must also mentor, train and delegate to members of the project team.

Core Competencies (based on Consilio’s Values)

  • Be flexible and embrace change;
  • Take ownership for providing outstanding service;
  • Value and respect the contributions of others, building trust and relationships with stakeholders;
  • Take initiative, act with urgency be accountable and demonstrate unwavering commitment to do the right thing
  • Recognize, develop and celebrate individual and team successes;
  • Utilize communication best practices and active listening techniques to meet stated needs
  • Lead with conviction.

Responsibilities

Management of Projects

  • Provide end-to-end oversight of multiple discovery matters and serve as primary client point of contact.
  • Provide expertise and consultative advice regarding data collections, processing, review workflows, analytics, and production/export deliverables.
  • Create and maintain project schedules and reporting, including defining activities, sequence of events, dependencies, work effort, duration and associated resource requirements.
  • Develop and manage relationships with internal teams.
  • Define, articulate, implement and monitor quality standards on all project deliverables.
  • Plan and manage internal and external project communications, ensuring effective exchange of project information and deliverables.
  • Serve as an expert on Consilio's review platforms and proprietary offerings.
  • Forecast, track and manage project budgets.
  • Successfully oversee multiple, concurrent projects.
  • Generate and distribute s reporting metrics and other identified KPIs on a regular basis as needed for each project.
  • Develop strong client relationships through collaborative, consultative service.

Support of Team and Colleagues

  • Be knowledgeable about, and able to speak competently to, all Consilio's service offerings.
  • Contribute and participate in, in conjunction with GRO/SCS, business development activities with existing and new clients, such as sales presentations, QBRs, or other account-level meetings and/or reporting to build relationships with client contacts.
  • Mentor and guide junior members of a portfolio team to ensure a successful relationship with both the client and the Project Management team.

Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree or minimum 3 years in the litigation support / legal industry;
  • 3 years experience using the Relativity platform or equivalent eDiscovery tools;
  • Willingness to travel;
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple, concurrent projects involving cross-functional teams within budgetary and schedule constraints;
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating project work and resources with global resources;
  • Demonstrated ability to manage client expectations and maintain client satisfaction;
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and the ability to anticipate client needs;
  • The ability to confront unexpected problems quickly and effectively;
  • Available for a flexible schedule driven by client requirements that will periodically exceed a standard 40 hour work week depending on project needs;
  • Strong teamwork, communication (written and oral), client management, and interpersonal skills;
  • Demonstrated ability to manage project teams, including teams of supporting project managers.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

The International Potato Center (CIP) is strengthening its institutional approach to Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) and Environmental and Social Management (ESM), appropriate to its mandate as an international agricultural research organization, its decentralized operating model, and the environmental and social risks associated with its research, operations, projects, partnerships and field activities.

Benchmarking with other CGIAR Centers and the CGIAR System Organization indicates ESG should not be treated solely as a sustainability reporting exercise: a credible approach also requires mechanisms to identify, assess, manage, monitor and evidence environmental and social risks across the organization and project lifecycle.CIP's approach therefore spans two complementary dimensions:

  • Institutional ESG and sustainability — CIP's own environmental, social and governance responsibilities and performance; and
  • Project-level environmental and social safeguards — risks and impacts associated with research, projects, field activities, partners, suppliers and communities.

CIP intends to build on its existing governance, enterprise risk management, project management, partner management and internal control arrangements, rather than establish a separate ESG structure. At the same time, CIP wishes to: become ready to demonstrate alignment with ISO 14001; establish a credible and proportionate ESG framework; strengthen safeguards to meet Green Climate Fund (GCF) and comparable climate-finance requirements; understand GCF requirements beyond ISO 14001; understand how far existing fiduciary and institutional systems already support GCF readiness; and build a baseline that responds efficiently to other donors

Objective:

The purpose of the consultancy is to establish where CIP is today; what target ESG and Environmental & Social Management architecture is appropriate for CIP; what gaps exist against ISO, GCF and relevant donor expectations; and what practical, proportionate steps CIP should take to close them.

The assignment is structured as three sequential phases. Phase 1 is scoped as a self-contained diagnostic and policy engagement that CIP can commission and complete on its own. Phases 2 and 3 build on Phase 1's findings and are intended to be scoped in detail — and commissioned — once Phase 1 is complete, so that their design reflects what the baseline and gap analysis actually show, rather than being fixed in advance.

This consultancy advertisement is for Phase 1 only. Phases 2 and 3 are indicative future phases and will be scoped and commissioned separately based on the findings of Phase 1.

The consultant should havedemonstrated experience assessing and designing ESG and environmental and social management frameworks in international or decentralized organizations. The ideal candidate will combine technical expertise in ISO 14001, environmental and social safeguards and climate-finance requirements with the ability to translate international standards into practical and proportionate institutional arrangements.

Deliverables:

Phase 1 — Diagnose and Frame (4–6 weeks)

Establish where CIP stands today against ISO 14001, institutional ESG maturity, GCF environmental and social safeguards readiness, and broader donor requirements. Deliver a validated current-state and maturity assessment, an integrated gap analysis, a draft CIP ESG/Environmental and Social Management Policy, and a management briefing with recommendations on Phase 2/3 scope and sequencing. Phase 1 is a self-contained engagement that CIP can act independently. See Annex A for the full topic taxonomy: environmental, social and governance sub-areas).

Phase 1 Deliverables

  • D1.1 — Inception Report and Requirements Crosswalk
  • D1.2 — CIP Current-State and Maturity Assessment
  • D1.3 — Integrated Gap Analysis (ISO / ESG / GCF safeguards / broader GCF institutional map / other donors)
  • D1.4 — Draft CIP ESG / Environmental & Social Management Policy
  • D1.5 — Management briefing on findings, with a recommendation on Phase 2/3 scope and sequencing

Requirements

  • Advanced degree or equivalent professional qualification in environmental management, ESG, sustainability, environmental and social safeguards, climate finance, international development, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience with ISO 14001 systems and conducting ISO readiness/gap assessments.
  • At least substantive experience of 10 years with environmental and social management systems and safeguards, and strong knowledge of IFC Performance Standards or comparable MDB safeguard frameworks.
  • Familiarity with GCF environmental, social and institutional requirements, and with gender, stakeholder engagement, grievance and safeguarding requirements in international development.
  • Experience with ESG/ESMS institutional maturity assessments, policy and roadmap development, and integrating safeguards into project and partner-management processes.
  • Ability to translate international standards into proportionate operational requirements; Excellent written and spoken English, with strong facilitation and communication skills at senior-management level.

Desirable:

  • Experience with CGIAR, international agricultural research organizations, MDBs, climate-finance institutions, or similarly decentralized international organizations.

Benefits

  • An excellent, collaborative working environment

Consultancy Duration

The initial consultancy contract will cover Phase 1 – Diagnose and Frame, for a total of 25 working days to be completed over a period of approximately 4–6 weeks. The assignment is expected to commence on or around September 21, 2026.

About SAP Fioneer:

Innovation is and will always be the core to SAP Fioneer, and it is the promise of why we were spun out of SAP: agility, innovation, and delivery.

SAP Fioneer builds on a heritage of outstanding technology and a deep understanding of corporate and consumer demands. At the heart of it all it is simple: We bring financial services to the next level with innovative software solutions and platforms.

We are helping companies in the financial services industry to achieve speed, scalability, and cost-efficiency through digital business innovation, cloud technology, and solutions that cover banking and insurance processes end-to-end.

A global company, rapid growth, innovative people, and a lean organization make SAP Fioneer a place where you accelerate your future!

About the Role

As a Senior or Lead Consultant for SAP Transactional Banking, you will act as a subject matter expert with deep expertise in the Transactional and Core Banking modules of the SAP Fioneer Platform. Your main responsibilities will include designing and implementing tailored solutions, optimizing related processes, and ensuring seamless integration within the IT landscapes of banks and financial institutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a specialist in SAP Transactional Banking within the SAP Fioneer Platform.
  • Leverage your in-depth knowledge to design and deliver effective, customer-centric solutions.
  • Optimize module-related processes to improve operational efficiency and performance.
  • Ensure smooth implementation and integration of solutions into existing infrastructures of banks.
  • Drive digitalization and process automation within the module to create measurable value for clients.
  • Contribute significantly to both initial implementations and the continuous evolution of the module.

You’ll be working with some of the brightest and most forward-thinking professionals in the industry. At SAP Fioneer, winning as a team is part of our DNA.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Business, Finance, Economics, Physics, or Mathematics.
  • 5+ years of relevant work experience leading and successfully implementing digital transformation projects in the financial services industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate SAP Transactional Banking (TRBK) or Core Banking solutions into existing banking infrastructures.
  • Proven track record of driving efficiency improvements within module functionalities for clients.
  • Experience contributing to both the initial implementation and the ongoing development of SAP banking modules.
  • Strong business acumen combined with solid IT solution design skills.
  • Business-fluent in German, both written and spoken.

Benefits

You will have the opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry on an incredibly ambitious project to shape the ever-evolving financial sector. This is an environment where you can have it all - the agility, enthusiasm and dynamism of a start-up, combined with the established expertise, solid market presence and extensive customer network of a more established organisation.

At SAP Fioneer, you will benefit from a flexible work environment that encourages creativity and encourages you to think outside the box, bring new ideas to the table, and challenge the status quo. You will become part of a diverse and global team that we are proud of and are constantly growing and reinventing. As an employee, you will have the chance to chart your own career path and take advantage of competitive compensation packages and progression opportunities based on merit.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes occupational pension provisions, support for health and wellbeing, various mobility options like bike leasing and transportation allowances, as well as additional perks such as celebration rewards, meal programs, jubilee recognition, and relocation reimbursement.

raw.description:
The Test Assembly Research Assistant reports to the Test Assembly Manager and works collaboratively across functional teams to support the assembly, layout, and quality control of large-scale online and print-based English language proficiency tests. This role also provides assistance in formatting test materials, ensuring alignment with CAL’s style guide, WCAG requirements, and print specifications. This role is responsible for accurately transferring test content into InDesign templates, performing quality control reviews, and supporting the production of error-free, accessible test forms and ancillary materials.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

Test Form Assembly and Layout

  • Transfer and lay out test content (text and graphics) in Adobe InDesign, following established templates, the CAL style guide, WCAG requirements, and print specifications.
  • Assist in the creation and maintenance of test booklets, administration scripts, and other ancillary test materials in both print and computer-based formats.
  • Assist in preparing and reviewing test blueprints and item inventories to support test form construction.
  • Collaborate with the Desktop Publishing Graphic Designer to implement layout adjustments and minor graphic edits in Adobe InDesign.

Quality Control and Review

  • Perform systematic quality control reviews of print-based and computer-based test materials to verify accuracy, consistency, and alignment with test specifications, content standards, WCAG requirements, and formatting requirements.
  • Review assessment materials using screen reader software to verify the accuracy of alternate text and document accessibility.
  • Support the Test Assembly Manager in maintaining, documenting, and improving quality control procedures and checklists.
  • Track stakeholder feedback, implement approved revisions, and maintain complete, auditable revision histories.
  • Support mock test administrations and revise materials based on findings and user feedback.

Documentation, Data, and Process Support

  • Maintain test item databases and item banks, ensuring records remain accurate, current, and complete.
  • Assist with the maintenance of the internal style guide and the documentation of test assembly procedures.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and adhere to test security protocols in the handling of secure assessment content.
  • Perform other responsibilities as assigned.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

The Test Assembly Research Assistant must have:

  • A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Graphic Design, Education, Applied Linguistics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • At least two years of experience contributing to the production of educational or assessment materials.
  • A high degree of proficiency with Adobe InDesign and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) gained in a professional or academic setting.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

The Test Assembly Research Assistant must be able to:

  • Follow established procedures, templates, and style guides with precision.
  • Apply quality control standards for print and digital production.
  • Sustain close attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture in a high-stakes production environment.
  • Manage competing and shifting priorities, prioritize tasks appropriately, and meet firm production deadlines.
  • Work collaboratively and communicate effectively across functional teams.
  • Work accurately with databases and test item banks

An ideal candidate for the Test Assembly Research Assistant position also has:

  • Experience with standardized educational assessments or operational test production.
  • Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Excellent organization, planning, and time management skills.
  • Familiarity with screen reader technologies such as JAWS and NVDA.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards for print and digital materials (e.g., Section 508, WCAG).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

COMPENSATION:

Minimum Salary: $61,285 ; Benefits eligible

Full-time

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to effectively communicate. The employee may be required to sit or stand in a stationary position for 50% of the time. This position constantly operates a computer and other office productivity equipment. CAL adheres to ADA compliance and guidelines as a common practice.

ADDITIONALINFORMATION

This job description summarizes the main duties of the job. It neither prescribes nor restricts the exact tasks that may be assigned to carry out these duties. This document should not be construed in any way to represent a contract of employment. Management reserves the right to review and revise this document at any time.

In addition to federal law requirements, CAL complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Through its work, CAL seeks solutions to issues involving language and culture as they relate to access and equity in education and society around the globe.

raw.description:
About EarnIn

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

POSITION SUMMARY

This role sits at the center of the People function, driving how we operate, evolve, and deliver at scale. You'll serve as the connective tissue across People sub-teams, bringing rigor, clarity, and momentum to the systems, programs, and initiatives that make the function run. As a builder and strategic operator, you'll shape the infrastructure and culture of how the People team works, while leading high-visibility, high-impact transformation projects on behalf of People leadership.

This is a remote role, with occasional travel to our Mountain View HQ required. The New York Metro base salary range for this full-time position is $201,000-$246,000, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Function-wide operations: Own the operating model for the People team — including cross-functional cadences, reporting, dashboards, and the systems that support how we work.
  • Core People programs management: Lead end-to-end planning and execution of compensation cycles, performance reviews, and engagement survey activation.
    • Note: Not all People moments; sub-teams still need to be accountable for their own execution.
  • Transformation & special projects: Drive selective, high-priority, cross-cutting initiatives on behalf of People leadership, including org design, process redesign, and strategic buildouts.
  • Sub-team operations: Serve as a central steward of project management, intake, and operational support across People sub-teams.
  • AI & automation: Identify and implement opportunities to modernize People workflows through AI tools, automation, and systems improvements.
  • Cross-functional liaison: Serve as the primary operational connector between the People team and cohorts like ELT, Finance, Legal, and IT — particularly on transformation initiatives.
  • Documentation & knowledge management: Own how the People team captures, stores, and shares its playbooks, SOPs, and program documentation — building a knowledge infrastructure that scales.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • A systems thinker who also executes — you can zoom out to see the full picture and zoom in to move work forward.
  • Experienced in HR/People functions, with a track record of building infrastructure and programs that scale.
  • Comfortable owning ambiguous, cross-functional work with senior stakeholders.
  • Energized by transformation
  • 7+ years of experience in HR, People Operations, or related fields
  • Experience using data and data-driven insights to support the business by offering solutions in line with values and business objectives
  • Change management skills
  • Passion for creating healthy, inclusive organizations where culture is a competitive advantage for a diverse employee population

At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn does not unlawfully discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. EarnIn is an E-Verify participant.

EarnIn does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.

raw.description:
Property Management Coordinator – Self-Storage Operations & Tenant Support | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and detail-oriented Property Management Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of a growing self-storage portfolio.

This role serves as the operational backbone of the business, ensuring customer inquiries, rentals, billing issues, delinquency management, move-ins, move-outs, and administrative processes are handled accurately and efficiently.

You’ll work closely with leadership and onsite teams to keep property management systems organized, customers supported, records accurate, and operational processes moving smoothly.

If you’re proactive, customer-focused, process-driven, and comfortable managing multiple responsibilities independently, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Customer Service & Tenant Support

  • Manage customer inquiries through phone, email, and messaging platforms
  • Assist customers with:
    • Reservations
    • Rentals
    • Move-ins and move-outs
    • Billing questions
    • Gate access issues
    • Lease-related inquiries
  • Maintain accurate customer records, notes, and communication history
  • Resolve customer concerns professionally and escalate issues when necessary
  • Ensure a positive customer experience throughout the rental lifecycle
  • Maintain timely and professional communication with tenants

Property Management Operations

  • Process new rentals and lease documentation
  • Coordinate move-in and move-out activities
  • Monitor unit occupancy and rental activity
  • Maintain accurate records across property management systems
  • Support daily operational tasks to ensure facilities run smoothly
  • Coordinate outstanding operational needs with leadership and onsite teams

Delinquency & Payment Management

  • Monitor delinquent accounts and outstanding balances
  • Send payment reminders, notices, and follow-up communications according to company policies
  • Assist customers with billing questions and payment-related concerns
  • Escalate delinquent accounts when required
  • Maintain accurate documentation of collection efforts and account status
  • Ensure delinquency follow-ups are completed consistently and on time

Administrative Coordination

  • Maintain organized records within property management systems
  • Coordinate with local teams when physical site support is required
  • Keep customer records, lease files, and supporting documentation accurate and current
  • Track outstanding tasks and ensure timely follow-up
  • Support leadership with operational and administrative projects
  • Maintain clear communication across internal teams

Systems, SOPs & Process Improvement

  • Create, document, and improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
  • Develop and maintain workflows for:
    • Lead management
    • Rentals
    • Move-ins
    • Move-outs
    • Delinquency management
    • Customer communication
    • Reporting
    • Escalations
  • Identify process improvements that increase operational efficiency and customer satisfaction
  • Help maintain consistent processes across all locations
  • Reduce operational gaps through clear documentation and structured workflows

Reporting & Operational Communication

  • Prepare regular reports covering:
    • Occupancy
    • Leads
    • Delinquency
    • Customer issues
    • Operational performance
  • Track unresolved issues and recommend solutions
  • Provide leadership with updates on operational trends
  • Identify opportunities for process and service improvements
  • Maintain clear communication between leadership and internal teams

Requirements

  • Native-level English communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Strong customer service experience
  • Typing speed of at least 60 WPM
  • Strong phone, email, and written communication skills
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, including:
    • Gmail
    • Google Drive
    • Google Docs
    • Google Sheets
  • Strong organizational and administrative skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open tasks and priorities simultaneously
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment
  • Reliable internet connection and dedicated workspace
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to work independently with consistent follow-through
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Property management experience
  • Self-storage industry experience
  • Leasing or tenant management experience
  • Administrative operations experience
  • Experience using AppFolio
  • Experience using Easy Storage Solutions
  • Experience creating or improving operational processes and SOPs
  • Experience managing billing inquiries and delinquency workflows

Tools & Platforms

AppFolio | Easy Storage Solutions | Google Workspace | Gmail | Google Drive | Google Docs | Google Sheets | Property Management Systems

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are highly organized and process-driven
  • Have a strong customer service mindset
  • Communicate confidently and professionally
  • Can manage multiple priorities without losing track of details
  • Proactively follow up instead of waiting for reminders
  • Work effectively without constant supervision
  • Enjoy building systems and improving operational processes
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation
  • Are reliable, professional, and solution-oriented
  • Take ownership of tasks from assignment through completion

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may start by reviewing new customer inquiries, upcoming rentals, outstanding move-ins or move-outs, and delinquent accounts requiring follow-up.

Throughout the day, you’ll respond to customers, process rentals, update lease documentation, coordinate with onsite teams, send payment reminders, and maintain accurate property management records.

You’ll also review operational reports and outstanding issues, update SOPs, improve workflows, and support leadership with administrative and operational priorities.

In short: you keep operations organized, customers supported, and property management systems running efficiently.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Customer response and resolution times
  • Occupancy and rental processing accuracy
  • Delinquency follow-up completion rates
  • Customer satisfaction scores and reviews
  • Accuracy of customer records and lease documentation
  • Timeliness of reporting and task completion
  • SOP creation and process improvement implementation
  • Overall operational efficiency and organization

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Hands-on ownership across self-storage property operations
  • Direct impact on customer experience and operational efficiency
  • Exposure to rentals, leasing, billing, delinquency, and tenant management
  • Opportunity to build and improve SOPs and operational workflows
  • Collaboration with leadership and onsite teams
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Potential career growth into:
    • Senior Property Management Coordinator
    • Property Operations Manager
    • Portfolio Operations
    • Property Management Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have strong customer service and administrative operations experience and enjoy keeping property management processes, tenant communication, billing, documentation, and follow-ups organized, we’d love to hear from you.

Experience in property management, self-storage, AppFolio, or Easy Storage Solutions will make you especially well suited for this opportunity.

Apply today and help keep a growing self-storage portfolio organized, responsive, and operationally efficient.

raw.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We're launching a major Product and Technology hiring push, and we need a Senior Technical Recruiter to lead full-cycle execution for a 6-month contract. This is a stand-alone, high-autonomy engagement: you will own a full slate of technical requisitions from day one, working directly in Greenhouse and LinkedIn Recruiter with no onboarding runway.

The right person already knows how to build a sourcing plan for a Staff Backend Engineer, credibly screen a candidate's Python versus Go experience, and tell a hiring manager why a strong React candidate isn't the right fit for a Rust-heavy infrastructure team. If that's you, you'll have real ownership and room to move fast.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

This contract is fully remote for eligible candidates across North America; preference will be given to candidates in Central (CDT) or Pacific (PT) time zones to support team collaboration.

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You'll Do

  • Run full-cycle recruiting for 8–12+ concurrent requisitions spanning Engineering (backend, frontend, mobile, infrastructure/DevOps, QA), AI/ML, Data, and Product, across seniority levels from mid-level IC through Staff, Principal, and Director, and across multiple markets/geographies.
  • Partner directly with engineering and product leaders to pressure-test role scope, success profiles, and hiring timelines, you bring the market read and the plan, not just the questions.
  • Build and execute sourcing strategies for hard-to-fill and niche technical searches using LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, technical communities, referrals, and Boolean/X-ray search, without waiting on inbound flow.
  • Conduct technical screens that actually assess depth — languages, frameworks, and architecture (e.g., Python, Go, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, Swift/Kotlin, cloud infrastructure, ML/AI tooling) so hiring managers only see candidates worth their time.
  • Own the requisition lifecycle in Greenhouse end to end: intake, pipeline hygiene, structured interview kits, scorecards, and reporting, configuring and troubleshooting workflows independently.
  • Design and run structured, consistent interview processes and debriefs that drive fast, confident hiring decisions.
  • Lead offer strategy and negotiation in partnership with the People team.
  • Deliver a polished, high-touch experience for senior and executive-level technical candidates from first outreach through offer.
  • Surface pipeline risk, market realities, and process bottlenecks proactively as this role reports up, it doesn't wait to be asked.

What You’ll Bring

  • 6+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience, with direct, hands-on ownership of Engineering, AI/ML, and Product hiring in high-growth, fast-moving environments.
  • A track record of independently managing 8–12+ concurrent technical requisitions across multiple functions, seniority levels (IC through Director/VP), and geographies.
  • Real technical fluency: you can discuss programming languages, frameworks, and system architecture (e.g., Python, Java, Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, Swift/Kotlin, cloud infrastructure, AI/ML stacks) well enough to source, screen, and advise hiring managers credibly, not just relay job descriptions.
  • Deep, current hands-on expertise in Greenhouse ATS (requisition setup, pipeline management, scorecards, reporting) and LinkedIn Recruiter (sourcing, InMail strategy, talent pool management) — these are day-one tools, not tools you'll be trained on.

About EarnIn

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

POSITION SUMMARY

This role sits at the center of the People function, driving how we operate, evolve, and deliver at scale. You'll serve as the connective tissue across People sub-teams, bringing rigor, clarity, and momentum to the systems, programs, and initiatives that make the function run. As a builder and strategic operator, you'll shape the infrastructure and culture of how the People team works, while leading high-visibility, high-impact transformation projects on behalf of People leadership.

This is a remote role, with occasional travel to our Mountain View HQ required. The New York Metro base salary range for this full-time position is $201,000-$246,000, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Function-wide operations: Own the operating model for the People team — including cross-functional cadences, reporting, dashboards, and the systems that support how we work.
  • Core People programs management: Lead end-to-end planning and execution of compensation cycles, performance reviews, and engagement survey activation.
    • Note: Not all People moments; sub-teams still need to be accountable for their own execution.
  • Transformation & special projects: Drive selective, high-priority, cross-cutting initiatives on behalf of People leadership, including org design, process redesign, and strategic buildouts.
  • Sub-team operations: Serve as a central steward of project management, intake, and operational support across People sub-teams.
  • AI & automation: Identify and implement opportunities to modernize People workflows through AI tools, automation, and systems improvements.
  • Cross-functional liaison: Serve as the primary operational connector between the People team and cohorts like ELT, Finance, Legal, and IT — particularly on transformation initiatives.
  • Documentation & knowledge management: Own how the People team captures, stores, and shares its playbooks, SOPs, and program documentation — building a knowledge infrastructure that scales.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • A systems thinker who also executes — you can zoom out to see the full picture and zoom in to move work forward.
  • Experienced in HR/People functions, with a track record of building infrastructure and programs that scale.
  • Comfortable owning ambiguous, cross-functional work with senior stakeholders.
  • Energized by transformation
  • 7+ years of experience in HR, People Operations, or related fields
  • Experience using data and data-driven insights to support the business by offering solutions in line with values and business objectives
  • Change management skills
  • Passion for creating healthy, inclusive organizations where culture is a competitive advantage for a diverse employee population

At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn does not unlawfully discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. EarnIn is an E-Verify participant.

EarnIn does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.

Property Management Coordinator – Self-Storage Operations & Tenant Support | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and detail-oriented Property Management Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of a growing self-storage portfolio.

This role serves as the operational backbone of the business, ensuring customer inquiries, rentals, billing issues, delinquency management, move-ins, move-outs, and administrative processes are handled accurately and efficiently.

You’ll work closely with leadership and onsite teams to keep property management systems organized, customers supported, records accurate, and operational processes moving smoothly.

If you’re proactive, customer-focused, process-driven, and comfortable managing multiple responsibilities independently, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Customer Service & Tenant Support

  • Manage customer inquiries through phone, email, and messaging platforms
  • Assist customers with:
    • Reservations
    • Rentals
    • Move-ins and move-outs
    • Billing questions
    • Gate access issues
    • Lease-related inquiries
  • Maintain accurate customer records, notes, and communication history
  • Resolve customer concerns professionally and escalate issues when necessary
  • Ensure a positive customer experience throughout the rental lifecycle
  • Maintain timely and professional communication with tenants

Property Management Operations

  • Process new rentals and lease documentation
  • Coordinate move-in and move-out activities
  • Monitor unit occupancy and rental activity
  • Maintain accurate records across property management systems
  • Support daily operational tasks to ensure facilities run smoothly
  • Coordinate outstanding operational needs with leadership and onsite teams

  • Monitor delinquent accounts and outstanding balances
  • Send payment reminders, notices, and follow-up communications according to company policies

  • Escalate delinquent accounts when required
  • Maintain accurate documentation of collection efforts and account status
  • Ensure delinquency follow-ups are completed consistently and on time

Administrative Coordination

  • Maintain organized records within property management systems
  • Coordinate with local teams when physical site support is required
  • Keep customer records, lease files, and supporting documentation accurate and current
  • Track outstanding tasks and ensure timely follow-up
  • Support leadership with operational and administrative projects
  • Maintain clear communication across internal teams

Systems, SOPs & Process Improvement

  • Create, document, and improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
  • Develop and maintain workflows for:
    • Lead management
    • Rentals
    • Move-ins
    • Move-outs
    • Delinquency management
    • Customer communication
    • Reporting
    • Escalations
  • Identify process improvements that increase operational efficiency and customer satisfaction
  • Help maintain consistent processes across all locations
  • Reduce operational gaps through clear documentation and structured workflows

Reporting & Operational Communication

  • Prepare regular reports covering:
    • Occupancy
    • Leads
    • Delinquency
    • Customer issues
    • Operational performance
  • Track unresolved issues and recommend solutions
  • Provide leadership with updates on operational trends
  • Identify opportunities for process and service improvements
  • Maintain clear communication between leadership and internal teams

Requirements

  • Native-level English communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Strong customer service experience
  • Typing speed of at least 60 WPM
  • Strong phone, email, and written communication skills
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, including:
    • Gmail
    • Google Drive
    • Google Docs
    • Google Sheets
  • Strong organizational and administrative skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open tasks and priorities simultaneously
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment
  • Reliable internet connection and dedicated workspace
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to work independently with consistent follow-through
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Property management experience
  • Self-storage industry experience
  • Leasing or tenant management experience
  • Administrative operations experience
  • Experience using AppFolio
  • Experience using Easy Storage Solutions
  • Experience creating or improving operational processes and SOPs
  • Experience managing billing inquiries and delinquency workflows

Tools & Platforms

AppFolio | Easy Storage Solutions | Google Workspace | Gmail | Google Drive | Google Docs | Google Sheets | Property Management Systems

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are highly organized and process-driven
  • Have a strong customer service mindset
  • Communicate confidently and professionally
  • Can manage multiple priorities without losing track of details
  • Proactively follow up instead of waiting for reminders
  • Work effectively without constant supervision
  • Enjoy building systems and improving operational processes
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation
  • Are reliable, professional, and solution-oriented
  • Take ownership of tasks from assignment through completion

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may start by reviewing new customer inquiries, upcoming rentals, outstanding move-ins or move-outs, and delinquent accounts requiring follow-up.

Throughout the day, you’ll respond to customers, process rentals, update lease documentation, coordinate with onsite teams, send payment reminders, and maintain accurate property management records.

You’ll also review operational reports and outstanding issues, update SOPs, improve workflows, and support leadership with administrative and operational priorities.

In short: you keep operations organized, customers supported, and property management systems running efficiently.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Customer response and resolution times
  • Occupancy and rental processing accuracy
  • Delinquency follow-up completion rates
  • Customer satisfaction scores and reviews
  • Accuracy of customer records and lease documentation
  • Timeliness of reporting and task completion
  • SOP creation and process improvement implementation
  • Overall operational efficiency and organization

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Hands-on ownership across self-storage property operations
  • Direct impact on customer experience and operational efficiency
  • Exposure to rentals, leasing, billing, delinquency, and tenant management
  • Opportunity to build and improve SOPs and operational workflows
  • Collaboration with leadership and onsite teams
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Potential career growth into:
    • Senior Property Management Coordinator
    • Property Operations Manager
    • Portfolio Operations
    • Property Management Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have strong customer service and administrative operations experience and enjoy keeping property management processes, tenant communication, billing, documentation, and follow-ups organized, we’d love to hear from you.

Experience in property management, self-storage, AppFolio, or Easy Storage Solutions will make you especially well suited for this opportunity.

Apply today and help keep a growing self-storage portfolio organized, responsive, and operationally efficient.

Arthrex is a global medical device company and a leader in new product development and medical education in orthopedics. Arthrex is actively seeking a Sr. Business Systems Analyst – Document Management Systems (DMS) to work directly with the IT team and Business partners within Arthrex to help facilitate process improvements through collaboration with Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, Product Engineering, Operations, and other business teams, as well as support the design, configuration, analysis, implementation, testing, and maintenance of the organization’s Document Management System (DMS) solutions. Excellent communication and analytical skills, strong technical project management skills, and experience supporting enterprise applications will be essential for this position. Join our talented team at a global medical device company focused on Helping Surgeons Treat Their Patients Better™.

Main Objective:

Responsible for facilitating process improvements engaging business and IT, as well as designing and/or configuring, analyzing, implementing, testing, and maintaining the organization’s on-premise and cloud computing applications, with primary emphasis on enterprise Document Management Systems (DMS). Serves as a senior business systems analyst and subject matter expert supporting Quality and Regulatory document processes, validated solutions, global business needs, and the reliable delivery of document and content management capabilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
