New Hire Starting Pay: $92,000 - $105,000 + Benefits Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!


About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.


The Role

As Technical Sales Manager, you play a central role in securing new business by leading the technical work behind audits and requests for proposals, as well as the technical component of the client-facing pitch. You coordinate contributions across Thrive’s teams, establish a clear audit narrative, and translate complex findings into credible, commercially relevant recommendations. You partner with Business Development to ensure every presentation accurately represents Thrive’s expertise, responds to the client’s needs, and strengthens confidence in choosing Thrive.

You also drive growth within existing client partnerships through proactive internal audits with the Performance team. By examining performance, identifying untapped opportunities, and clearly demonstrating the value of Thrive’s work, you help teams protect strong partnerships and build the case for thoughtful expansion.

You own the quality and evolution of Thrive’s audit discipline, including its methods, standards, internal artifacts, and client-facing outputs. You coach contributors, coordinate stakeholders, maintain technical rigour, and ensure recommendations remain grounded in evidence and aligned with Thrive’s delivery capabilities.

Your responsibilities will be:

  • Domain: Own the technical audit discipline, ensuring every assessment is scoped, evidence-based, repeatable, and translated into commercially relevant recommendations.
  • Client: Build client confidence by leading complex technical conversations, clarifying expectations, and connecting evidence-based recommendations to business goals.
  • People: Develop our audit capability through practical training, direct coaching, quality feedback, and clear standards for technical and client-facing work.
  • Company: Drive growth by supporting qualification, uncovering expansion opportunities, strengthening market credibility, and turning audit insights into service innovation.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

  • In your first 30 days, you’ll learn Thrive’s sales process, observe client pitches and conversations, and begin leading technical components of calls, as well as begin leading sales-focused audits with some support.
  • In your first 60 days, you’ll lead technical components of client pitches and conversations, and lead sales-driven Audits & RFPs.
  • In your first 90 days, you’ll own all technical components of client pitches and conversations, and lead sales-driven audits & RFPs from back end analysis through to pitch.

Qualifications

  • You’ve directly managed and optimized low-to-high complexity e-commerce and demand generation accounts, including multimillion-dollar annual media investments.
  • You’ve worked inside active advertising accounts to diagnose measurement, structure, budgeting, targeting, creative, and performance challenges alongside delivery teams.
  • You’ve led end-to-end technical audits, turning account-level evidence into prioritized recommendations, practical actions, and commercially relevant growth opportunities.
  • You’ve presented and defended technical recommendations to executive and senior marketing stakeholders during high-stakes new-business and expansion conversations.
  • You’ve coordinated sales, strategy, media, creative, and data contributors across audits and requests for proposal, owning scope, timelines, narrative, and quality.
  • You’ve strengthened internal operations through proactive audits, hands-on team support, repeatable standards, improved workflows, and contributor training.


---

Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

This is a remote position.

Managing Clinical Interviewer – Digital Mental Health Research (Doctoral-Level)

Location:US RemoteJob Type:Full-Time, PermanentCompensation:$135,000–$165,000, commensurate with experience

About the Role

Deliberate is looking for a doctoral-level mental health specialist to lead our clinical interviewer team. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity to work at the intersection of clinical psychology and technology — conducting and overseeing structured clinical assessments while gaining direct exposure to AI-driven digital mental health assessment, biomarker research, and clinical trials designed for both scientific rigor and real-world impact.

This role directly supportsfederally funded research projects developing and validating AI-driven mental health biomarkers— work that sits at the leading edge of how mental health conditions are measured and assessed. You'll work alongside academic and industry leaders in mental health, with regular supervision from licensed faculty, in a fast-moving start-up environment where your clinical judgment and leadership directly shape the quality and reliability of the data behind these tools.

As the Managing Clinical Interviewer, you'll conduct assessments yourself while also owning the day-to-day performance, training, and reliability of the broader clinical interviewer team — a natural next step for an experienced clinical researcher ready to take on people leadership alongside their clinical work.

What You'll Do

Team leadership and quality oversight

  • Oversee daily operations of clinical interviewers, including workload, productivity, participant rapport, participant retention skills, and clinical accuracy

  • Assist in hiring and training new clinical interviewers

  • Conduct weekly rating calibration meetings and review of ratings to enhance inter-rater reliability

  • Serve as the first point of contact for clinical interviewer questions and problem-solving

Clinical assessment

  • Conduct and rate comprehensive clinical assessments and interviews with research participants

  • Screen participants for eligibility and administer study questionnaires

  • Accurately collect, organize, and enter research data into designated forms and databases

  • Adhere to best practices in data management throughout the study lifecycle

  • Participate in calibration meetings to ensure assessment reliability

  • Ensure compliance with all institutional, state, and federal regulations relevant to the study

  • Provide administrative support, including scheduling meetings and organizing participant visits

  • Collaborate with faculty and the research team to ensure effective study execution

What You'll Need

  • Completed doctoral degree in clinical psychology, counseling psychology, psychiatry, or a closely related mental health field

  • At least 4 years of experience conducting clinical interviews for research studies. Experience administering the SCID, MINI, MADRS, and/or HAMD, preferred.

  • At least 1 year of prior experience training and/or supervising other clinical interviewers

  • Experience assessing patients with depression and other mental health conditions

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with demonstrated ability to give clear, constructive feedback

  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail

  • Interest in working in a fast-paced technology start-up environment

  • Ability to work occasional evening and/or weekend hours to accommodate participant schedules(Note: role is US remote; occasional flexibility across time zones may be needed — confirm specific overlap expectations, if any.)

What We Offer

  • Salary range of $135,000–$165,000, commensurate with experience

  • A permanent, full-time position with room to grow within the clinical research team

  • A leadership role with direct influence over interviewer quality, training, and reliability standards

  • Direct mentorship and biweekly supervision from licensed faculty on clinical assessment methods

  • Hands-on exposure to AI-driven digital mental health assessment and biomarker research

  • The opportunity to work closely with academic and business leaders shaping the future of digital mental health

  • Fully remote work

  • [Add: health insurance, PTO, retirement matching, CE/licensure support, equity, etc. — whatever applies]

Application Process

Interested candidates should submit a CV and a cover letter outlining their interest and qualifications for the role. We encourage applications from a diverse range of backgrounds.

Join Our Team

Deliberate is building the next generation of AI-driven mental health assessment tools, backed by federally funded research into developing and validating AI-driven mental health biomarkers — and this role puts you at the center of that work, leading the team responsible for the clinical data quality it all depends on. You'll support critical product development while building leadership and clinical research experience that translates directly to a future in clinical research, digital mental health, or clinical practice.

raw.title: VFX Artist - GameSim - Talent Pipeline
raw.excerpt: GameSim is a game development studio that partners with clients to build games across PC/console and a range of art styles.
raw.description:
GameSim is a game development studio that partners with clients to build games across PC/console and a range of art styles. We care about craftsmanship, collaboration, and shipping work we’re proud to put our names on. If you love building environments and believable spaces we’d like to meet you. Our headquarters is based in Orlando, FL!

Talent Pipeline Posting Notice
Please note that this posting is not tied to an immediate vacancy. We are proactively building a pipeline of qualified candidates in anticipation of potential hiring needs over the coming months. Applications will be reviewed and retained for future consideration as opportunities arise.

We are looking for a VFX Artist with strong real-time effects skills, solid technical judgment, and the potential to grow into broader lead responsibilities over time.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating high-quality visual effects while also helping teams stay aligned, organized, and efficient. Depending on the project, this person may contribute directly to hands-on VFX production, in-engine implementation, feedback, task breakdowns, optimization, workflow documentation, and cross-discipline collaboration.

Because our projects can vary widely in style, scope, platform, and client needs, we are looking for an adaptable VFX artist with strong fundamentals, a practical production mindset, and the ability to translate creative or design direction into clear, executable effects work.

This is a hands-on production role with opportunities to support small pods or strike teams, guide VFX quality, mentor other artists, and grow toward lead-level responsibilities.

This role offers flexible work options, including remote, hybrid or in-office arrangements.

Responsibilities

  • Create custom real-time visual effects and implement them in-engine using Unreal Engine 5, Unity, or proprietary tools.
  • Build high-quality effects for gameplay, environments, cinematics, atmosphere, combat, interaction, destruction, UI/game feedback, and other project needs.
  • Create all necessary textures, flipbooks, materials, meshes, simulations, and supporting assets for real-time VFX.
  • Maintain clean, readable, well-structured material graphs, Niagara systems, parameters, naming conventions, and reusable effect setups.
  • Use tools such as Photoshop, Substance Designer, Blender, Houdini, Maya, EmberGen, or other software as needed to support effect creation.
  • Work with complex material setups, Blueprints, scripting hooks, animation events, gameplay triggers, or engine-specific implementation needs.
  • Troubleshoot VFX issues in partnership with Technical Art, Engineering, Design, Animation, Audio, and other disciplines.
  • Own VFX optimization fundamentals, including particle counts, overdraw, shader cost, texture memory, spawn rates, scalability settings, and platform performance constraints.
  • Help ensure effects are readable, performant, and aligned with gameplay needs, art direction, timing, mood, and player feedback.
  • Review work from internal artists, partner studios, or external vendors and provide clear, constructive, actionable feedback.
  • Help maintain a consistent quality bar across a set of effects, a feature, a level, or a small team pod.
  • Support short-term planning by helping break down VFX requests into clear tasks, priorities, dependencies, risks, and definitions of done.
  • Proactively identify production risks, including missing gameplay hooks, performance spikes, unclear direction, pipeline gaps, dependency issues, or inconsistent style execution.
  • Collaborate closely with Designers, Concept Artists, Art Directors, Technical Artists, Engineers, Animators, Audio Designers, and Producers.
  • Support client-facing communication when needed by clarifying requirements, sharing WIP, explaining constraints, and aligning on expected outcomes.
  • Contribute to VFX workflow improvements, reusable templates, documentation, libraries, naming standards, or scalability rules when appropriate.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional game industry experience as a real-time VFX Artist or similar role.
  • At least one shipped game title.
  • Proven end-to-end real-time VFX workflow experience, from concept and asset creation through in-engine implementation and polish.
  • Strong experience implementing effects in Unreal Engine 4 or 5, with strong working knowledge of Niagara.
  • Strong particle animation fundamentals, including timing, rhythm, shape language, motion, impact, anticipation, dissipation, and readability.
  • Strong understanding of natural energies and materials such as fire, smoke, water, electricity, magic, dust, debris, explosions, atmospherics, and environmental effects.
  • Strong material and texture creation skills using tools such as Photoshop, Substance Designer, or similar software.
  • Ability to create clean, readable, and well-constructed material graphs and VFX systems.
  • Demonstrated understanding of real-time VFX optimization, including particle counts, overdraw, memory usage, material cost, scalability, and performance constraints.
  • Ability to balance visual impact, gameplay clarity, technical cost, and production schedule.
  • Strong communication skills, including clear written updates, verbal communication, documentation, and actionable feedback.
  • Ability to interpret vague creative, design, or client direction and turn it into clear VFX tasks or implementation plans.
  • Experience mentoring, reviewing, or guiding other artists. A formal Lead title is not required, but leadership behaviors are important.
  • Comfortable collaborating across disciplines and working with design, engineering, technical art, production, and art direction.
  • Strong ownership, follow-through, organization, and problem-solving ability.
  • Interest in growing into broader leadership responsibilities over time.

Nice to Have

  • Proficiency with common production tools such as Perforce, Jira, Miro, and Confluence.
  • Houdini experience.
  • EmberGen experience.
  • Unity experience.
  • Substance Designer experience.
  • Experience with proprietary engines or custom VFX tools.
  • Scripting or coding skills, such as C#, Python, Blueprint, or similar.
  • 2D animation or traditional animation experience.
  • 3D animation, simulation, or procedural content creation experience.
  • Experience creating both stylized and realistic effects.
  • Experience with foliage, atmospherics, environmental effects, weather, destruction, or ambient world VFX.
  • Experience working with outsourcing, co-development teams, partner studios, or external vendors.
  • Experience collaborating with teams across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
  • Experience establishing VFX standards, templates, naming conventions, libraries, scalability rules, or pipeline documentation.
  • Experience supporting client reviews, milestone deliveries, or cross-studio feedback loops.
  • Experience leading a small pod, strike team, feature group, or informal group of artists.

Portfolio Requirements

  • Please include a portfolio that clearly demonstrates your real-time VFX capabilities.
  • Your portfolio must include:
    • Real-time VFX assets with strong readability, timing, shape language, and clearly understandable visual elements.
    • At least one example shown in a real-time gameplay context, preferably a video of the effect happening in-game or during interactive gameplay.
    • Examples of strong material definition and texture work, with clean, readable, well-constructed setups.
    • Effects that demonstrate fundamentals such as composition, mood, color choices, timing, motion, impact, readability, and understanding of natural energies.
    • Examples of effects implemented in-engine, preferably in Unreal Engine 4 or 5 / Niagara.
    • Breakdowns showing your process, including textures, materials, emitters, timing, implementation, optimization, or technical setup where applicable.
    • Clear explanations of what you personally created, especially for any team-created work.
  • Strongly preferred portfolio examples include:
    • Before/after examples showing how you improved an effect through feedback, mentorship, optimization, or art direction.
    • A small set of effects that demonstrate consistent style, quality bar, or gameplay readability across a feature or content set.
    • Examples of templates, libraries, material systems, naming conventions, scalability setups, or pipeline improvements you helped create.
    • Examples that show how you balanced visual quality with performance constraints.

Please note: if your portfolio is mostly isolated effects in presentation scenes without runtime gameplay context, this may not be the right fit. We are looking for artists who understand how VFX function inside real-time gameplay, not just how they look in isolation.

How to apply

  • Resume + portfolio link required.
  • An art test may be required as part of the process.

This position is currently open to candidates residing in the following U.S. states only:

Arizona (AZ), Connecticut (CT), Florida (FL), lowa (IA), Illinois (IL), Massachusetts (MA), Maine (ME), Michigan (MI), Minnesota (MN), New Hampshire (NH), Nevada (NV), Ohio (OH), Oregon (OR), South Carolina (SC), Tennessee (TN), Texas (TX), Virginia (VA), Wisconsin (WI), Montana (MT), Alabama (AL), Georgia (GA), Indiana (IN), Louisiana (LA), North Carolina (NC), New Jersey (NJ), Oklahoma (OK), and Utah (UT).

While applicants from all listed states will be considered, the ideal candidate will be located in Orlando (FL) Austin (TX) or New Orleans (LA). Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and reside in one of the eligible states listed above.

Salary Range: $70,000 USD to $75,000 USD

Benefits

What's in it for you?

  • Opportunity to work on different projects
  • 3 weeks of accrued paid time off
  • Benefits package including medical, dental and vision
  • Sick Leave
  • Disability Coverage
  • Corporate holidays
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with company matching
  • Professional Development
  • Snacks, drinks, ping pong, and more!

GameSim is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and evaluate candidates based on skills, experience, and alignment with the role.

Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavor to create a workplace which provides for equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees.

PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY

raw.description:

Freelance AI-Supported Copywriter

ALSO Marketing Agency & Brand, CoC Marketing

Europe - Remote

Role Overview

ALSO is looking for an experienced Freelance AI-Supported Copywriter to provide flexible content and editorial support to the Corporate CoC Marketing team.

The freelancer will support ALSO’s content engine across a broad range of formats, including LinkedIn content, blogs, thought leadership, corporate campaigns, executive communications, website copy and future digital content formats.

This role combines excellent copywriting, storytelling and editorial capabilities with advanced experience in AI-assisted content creation. AI should be used as a productivity and ideation accelerator; however, the freelancer remains fully responsible for transforming AI-generated drafts into accurate, engaging and audience-focused content that meets ALSO’s brand, quality and editorial standards.

The freelancer will work closely with the Content Strategy, Project Manager, European Marketing Manger. Assignments will be provided based on current priorities, campaigns and available project demand.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create, edit and optimize high-quality English-language content for corporate and B2B audiences.
  • Support the development of LinkedIn posts, articles, blogs, thought leadership pieces, campaign copy, executive communications, website content and other marketing materials.
  • Translate complex business, technology and industry topics into clear, engaging and audience-relevant narratives.
  • Develop content based on approved briefings, strategic messaging, campaign objectives and target-audience requirements.
  • Use Company AI tools to support research, ideation, drafting, content variation and optimization.
  • Critically review, fact-check, edit and improve all AI-assisted outputs before submission.
  • Ensure that content reflects ALSO’s positioning, tone of voice, terminology and editorial standards.
  • Adapt content for different channels, audiences, markets and stages of the customer journey.
  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback and manage agreed correction rounds efficiently.
  • Collaborate with content owners, project managers, designers, subject-matter experts and other contributors.
  • Deliver content within agreed timelines and according to the defined approval process.
  • Proactively recommend content angles, formats and storytelling approaches where appropriate.

Expected Deliverables

Assignments may include:

  • Corporate and executive LinkedIn posts
  • Social media campaign copy
  • Blog articles and editorial content
  • Thought leadership articles and opinion pieces
  • Executive communications and leadership messaging
  • Campaign headlines, key messages and calls to action
  • Website and landing-page copy
  • Email and newsletter content
  • Interview-based articles and stakeholder stories
  • Content summaries, adaptations and repurposed formats
  • AI-assisted content variations for testing and localization
  • Editorial reviews and quality assurance of existing copy
  • The exact scope, timeline, deliverables and estimated effort will be defined for each assignment through the applicable ALSO briefing and project-management process.

Requirements

  • Proven professional experience in copywriting, content marketing, journalism, corporate communications or a comparable editorial role.
  • Excellent English writing, editing and storytelling skills, ideally at native or near-native level.
  • Strong understanding of B2B marketing, corporate communications, digital content and social media.
  • Demonstrated experience creating content for technology, IT, cloud, cybersecurity, digital platforms or other complex business environments is highly desirable.
  • Practical experience using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or comparable technologies.
  • Strong prompting capabilities and the ability to generate consistent, high-quality AI-assisted outputs.
  • Ability to critically assess, fact-check and substantially improve AI-generated content.
  • Strong understanding of audience-focused writing, thought leadership and business storytelling.
  • Ability to work with corporate messaging, brand guidelines and defined approval processes.
  • Excellent attention to detail, linguistic quality and factual accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple assignments and meet agreed deadlines.
  • Professional and reliable communication with international stakeholders.
  • Additional European languages, particularly German, are an advantage.

Working Model

This is a freelance support assignment based on project demand and agreed capacity. It does not represent a permanent employment position or guarantee a fixed volume of work.

The freelancer is expected to:

  • Work independently within agreed briefings, deadlines and budgets.
  • Record and report working hours or project-based effort as agreed.
  • Use ALSO’s designated collaboration and project-management tools.
  • Follow the applicable content, brand, approval, confidentiality and data-protection requirements.
  • Clearly disclose the use of AI where required and ensure that no confidential information is entered into unauthorized AI systems.
  • Submit only professionally reviewed and publication-ready content.
  • Maintain confidentiality regarding all non-public ALSO, customer, vendor and partner information.

Collaboration and Quality Expectations

The Freelance AI-Supported Copywriter is expected to act as a reliable extension of the Corporate CoC Marketing team. Successful collaboration requires responsiveness, transparency, strong editorial judgement and the ability to translate feedback into high-quality content efficiently.

All deliverables must be original, factually accurate, aligned with the approved briefing and suitable for the intended audience and communication channel. AI-generated content must never be submitted without professional editorial review and refinement.

Application

Interested freelancers are invited to submit:

A current CV

Relevant writing samples or portfolio links

Examples of B2B, technology or thought leadership content

Information about experience with AI-assisted content creation

Current availability and preferred working capacity

Hourly or project-based rate

Language capabilities

We welcome experienced, creative and commercially minded copywriters who combine strong editorial craftsmanship with a responsible and effective use of AI.

Please submit your CV in English.

Über uns

Serielle Sanierung von Mehrfamilienhäusern – für eine klimaneutrale Zukunft des Wohnungssektors

Bis 2045 planen wir insgesamt eine Gigatonne CO2 im Wohnungssektor durch serielle energetische Sanierungen einzusparen. Das ist ein globaler Impact! Wir sind DER Partner der Wohnungswirtschaft für bezahlbare energetische Sanierung. Als Generalübernehmer begleiten wir Wohnungsunternehmen von der Erstidee bis zur massenfähigen, seriellen Umsetzung. Mithilfe digitaler Planung verlagern wir 80 % der Wertschöpfung von der Baustelle in die Fabrik. So gelingt die wirtschaftliche Transformation des gesamten Wohnungsbestands hin zur Klimaneutralität.

Ganz nach dem Motto "remote first" suchen wir für unser Berliner Headquarter oder deutschlandweit nach fähigen Expert*innen und Führungskräften.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine*n Projektmanager*in Hochbau (in Berlin oder remote) in Vollzeit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du trägst die Verantwortung für den ganzheitlichen Erfolg unserer seriellen Sanierungsprojekte
  • Dabei übernimmst du das Projektmanagement von anspruchsvollen und innovativen Sanierungsbauprojekten, von der Vorplanung über die Ausschreibung, Vergabe bis hin zur Bauüberwachung und Inbetriebnahme
  • Du führst die Projekte insbesondere in Bezug auf Organisation, Termine, Kosten, Gebäudequalitäten und Risiken und bist hauptverantwortlich für den ganzheitlichen Projekterfolg
  • Zu deinen regelmäßigen Aufgaben gehören u.a. Themen wie Ablaufplanung und -kontrolle sowie die Budgetkontrolle
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Planungsabteilung, dem Einkauf und der zuständigen Bauleitung zusammen und stimmst die Schnittstellen im Projekt mit dem Team ab; dabei bist du außerdem erste*r Ansprechpartner*in für unsere Kunden
  • Du erkennst aktiv und frühzeitig Risiken und kannst entsprechend gegensteuern
  • Wir wollen jeden Tag ein bisschen besser werden und freuen uns darauf, wenn du mit deiner Expertise Optimierungspotenziale erkennst und Verbesserungsideen einbringst

So passt du zu uns

  • Du hast ein Studium der Fachrichtung Bauingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Architektur erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder besitzt eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Du bringst fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Projektleitung von Bauprojekten mit, idealerweise in der Sanierung oder in der Wohnungswirtschaft
  • Du hast sehr gute Kenntnisse in der VOB, HOAI und AHO
  • Du besitzt die Bereitschaft zu projektabhängigen Reisen innerhalb Deutschlands
  • Du bist ein Organisationstalent und hast eine sehr strukturierte Arbeitsweise - auch wenn es mal hektisch wird, verlierst du nie den Überblick
  • Du achtest auf Details und hast eine Affinität für Zahlen und Daten
  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür bei der Verhandlung mit Partnern, hast diplomatisches Geschick und beschreibst dich selbst als kooperativ
  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team und packst gerne selbst mit an
  • Du hast richtig Lust, die Baubranche in Deutschland zu revolutionieren und an einer massiven CO2-Neutralität unseres Gebäudebestands mitzuwirken

Was wir dir bieten

  • Bis 2045 planen wir insgesamt eine Gigatonne CO2 im Wohnungssektor durch serielle energetische Sanierungen einzusparen. Das ist ein globaler Impact!
    our mission. no emission.
  • Du leistest einen entscheidenden Beitrag zu einer CO2-freien Zukunft
  • Eine zentrale Rolle mit vielen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten in einem aufstrebenden Construction Tech Start-up in unserem Büro in Berlin oder remote
  • Eine attraktive Vergütung mit einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und 30 Urlaubstagen
  • Benefits im Rahmen unseres Feelgood-Programms (Zuschuss zum BVG Ticket, Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft)
  • Nach erfolgreich bestandener Probezeit kannst du auf ein individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.500 Euro pro Jahr zurückgreifen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne Kernarbeitszeiten
  • Und für die Extraportion Flexibilität: Dank unserer Working-Abroad-Regelung kannst du bis zu 60 Arbeitstage im Jahr aus dem Ausland arbeiten
  • Ein wertschätzender, ehrlicher und transparenter Umgang miteinander und regelmäßige Company- und Teamevents

Ein kurzer Hinweis zum Schluss:

Für uns ist es nicht wichtig, wie du aussiehst, wie alt du bist oder welchen familiären Hintergrund du hast. Was für uns zählt, sind deine Stärken und deine Persönlichkeit. Deshalb bitten wir dich, in deiner Bewerbung auf ein Foto sowie auf Angaben zu Geburtsdatum, Familienstand oder familiärem Hintergrund zu verzichten – Chancengleichheit steht für uns an erster Stelle.

As an Senior EHR Project Manager, Acute Facility Deployments at Community Health Systems (CHS) – Shared Business Operations, you’ll play a vital role in supporting our purpose to help people get well and live healthier by providing safe, quality healthcare, building enduring relationships with our patients, and providing value for the people and communities we serve. Our team members enjoy a robust benefits package including:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription)
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Education support and student loan assistance

Job Summary

The Senior EHR Project Manager, Acute Facility Deployments independently manages multiple projects involving OracleHealth EHR, information systems, and database management. This role requires experience with multi-facility design, planning, execution, and oversight of complex initiatives.

The Senior EHR Project Manager, Acute Facility Deployments will be responsible for the technical aspects of project management and will coordinate with departmental and cross-functional teams to deliver expert-level customer support. They must possess comprehensive knowledge of all phases of the EHR system, deployments, and ongoing support.

The ideal candidate is confident in leading projects, managing vendor resources, and ensuring on-time, on-budget delivery. Strong communication skills and adherence to corporate and departmental policies are essential.

Essential Functions

  • This role requires a strong team leader who can coordinate efforts among multiple stakeholders. Successful implementation involves managing expectations of hospital executives and physicians, collaborating with local medical staff (nurses and technicians), engaging local technical resources (systems analysts and programmers), and working closely with vendor support teams.
  • Ensures projects are executed with precision by applying strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through to drive tasks, deliverables, and milestones to completion.
  • Develops and maintains project management tools and documentation to ensure comprehensive planning, execution, and tracking of all project activities, from business requirements through project completion.
  • Manages large-scale or mission-critical projects with complex scope and high visibility.
  • Leads stakeholder engagement, executive updates, and vendor relationships.
  • Owns project financials, including budgeting, forecasting, and contract alignment.
  • Anticipates and mitigates risks across work streams and resource groups.
  • Delivers clear and compelling executive presentations and dashboards.
  • Collaborates closely with enterprise PMO teams to ensure adherence to standards.
  • Mentors junior project team members and promotes best practices.
  • Supports vendor management and contract alignment in accordance with project needs.
  • Promotes consistency by applying PMO standards, templates, and methodologies.
  • Champions adoption and change management efforts across the business.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.
  • This is a fully remote opportunity.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or related field required
  • 5-7 years of experience managing projects, preferably in a technology, digital, or enterprise setting required
  • Experience managing high-budget projects and leading vendor partnerships required

Preferred:

  • At least 5 years of experience with Acute Facility EHR Implementation highly preferred
  • At least 3 years of experience with SmartSheet preferred.
  • Expert level proficiency in Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Project)

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Advanced project leadership skills with the ability to lead large-scale, high-visibility, or mission-critical initiatives across business and technical domains.
  • Demonstrated experience navigating matrixed organizations and aligning cross-functional teams toward shared goals.
  • Expert-level understanding of project lifecycles, delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid), and PMO governance standards.
  • Proven ability to lead vendor engagements, manage complex scopes, and ensure successful delivery across internal and external partners.
  • Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to deliver strategic presentations and status updates to senior leadership.
  • Deep experience managing project financials, including complex budgeting, forecasting, and contract alignment.
  • Proficiency in project and collaboration tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, Asana.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Certified Project Management Professional (PMP)-PMI or obtained within six (6) months of employment required

We know it’s not just about finding a job. It’s about finding a place where you are respected, valued and where your work is purposeful and fulfilling. A place where your talent is recognized, professional development is encouraged and career advancement is possible.

Community Health Systems is one of the nation’s leading healthcare providers. Developing and operating healthcare delivery systems in 40 distinct markets across 15 states, CHS is committed to helping people get well and live healthier. CHS operates 71 acute-care hospitals and more than 1,000 other sites of care, including physician practices, urgent care centers, freestanding emergency departments, occupational medicine clinics, imaging centers, cancer centers and ambulatory surgery centers.

We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.

About the Role

The Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) team is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead the design, development, and adoption of AI-native capabilities across our billing and revenue cycle platform.

This role combines deep software engineering expertise with hands-on experience building production AI systems. You will help transform how healthcare organizations manage billing, payments, claims, and operational workflows by applying Large Language Models (LLMs), intelligent automation, retrieval systems, and agentic AI architectures to solve real-world business problems.

As a senior individual contributor, you will operate at the intersection of platform architecture, AI systems engineering, and business transformation. You will influence technical strategy across teams, design reusable AI capabilities, and establish engineering standards for building reliable, secure, and scalable AI-powered systems.

Your impact will come through technical leadership, architectural ownership, hands-on implementation, and your ability to translate complex business challenges into intelligent software solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.

Your Area of Focus

  • Identify and implement practical opportunities to embed AI into backend services and business workflows where it can improve efficiency, accuracy, or decision support.
  • Design and build production-ready AI-enabled services that combine application logic, APIs, and AI models to support real customer and operational use cases.
  • Integrate LLMs, ML models, and external AI services into existing systems using strong engineering patterns for reliability, observability, and maintainability.
  • Build workflows that use AI in a bounded, auditable way, with clear fallback behavior, evaluation, and human review where appropriate.
  • Partner with product, design, data, and operational teams to turn workflow pain points into scalable software solutions with measurable impact.
  • Lead Software Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable and maintainable software applications using Spring Boot, Java, React, and cloud technologies.
  • Architect and Design: Collaborate with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to architect robust and scalable solutions that meet business requirements. Provide input into the technical direction of the team and product.
  • Cloud Technology Expertise: Leverage experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.) to design cloud-native applications. Ensure that applications are optimized for scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency in a cloud environment.
  • Code Reviews & Mentorship: Conduct thorough code reviews, ensuring that the team adheres to best practices for clean, maintainable, and efficient code. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with product and design teams to define requirements, deliver timely solutions, and provide technical expertise throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Performance and Optimization: Monitor and optimize the performance of applications. Identify bottlenecks and implement performance improvements across both frontend (React) and backend (Java/Spring Boot) layers.
  • Agile Development: Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives, and backlog grooming. Contribute to defining and prioritizing work within the team.
  • Stay Current: Continuously research and apply emerging technologies and industry best practices to improve the development process and product quality.

Your Professional Qualifications

  • Experience & Seniority: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building scalable distributed systems, with a track record of driving technical direction and architecture decisions without formal authority.
  • Core Technical Stack: Absolute mastery of Java, Spring Boot, and Python for developing secure, high-throughput, cloud-native backend systems (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Production AI Experience: 2–3+ years of hands-on experience designing, shipping, and maintaining production AI-enabled or AI-native applications (combining LLMs, core application logic, and business workflows).
  • AI Orchestration & Architecture: Practical experience with orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI) and a deep understanding of RAG, tool calling, prompt engineering, context/state management, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
  • Systems Infrastructure & Data: Strong background in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and messaging platforms (e.g., Kafka).
  • Production Safeguards & MLOps: Proven experience implementing enterprise AI guardrails, including real-time observability, latency/cost monitoring, automated evaluation pipelines, and robust fallback mechanisms.
  • Collaboration: Impact-driven mindset with excellent cross-functional communication skills to bridge Engineering, Product, Design, and Operations.
  • Advanced Agentic AI: Experience building autonomous, multi-step agentic systems utilizing multi-tier memory networks and recursive reasoning preferred.
  • Domain Expertise: Prior background in Healthcare IT, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), billing, claims processing, fintech, or similarly regulated, high-compliance transaction environments preferred.
  • Deep Data Retrieval: Hands-on experience with vector databases, semantic search architectures, and enterprise knowledge graph construction preferred.
  • Advanced ML Tooling: Exposure to PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, custom embedding models, fine-tuning methodologies, or model serving optimization.
  • Leadership Pedigree: Past experience serving as a Founding Engineer, Principal Architect, or early-stage platform lead driving organization-wide AI/ML adoption frameworks preferred.

(For Recruiter use only)

Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. raw.title: Renewal Manager
raw.excerpt: Who are we? At Leadership Connect, we believe that relationships are everything in business and in life.
raw.description:
Who are we?

At Leadership Connect, we believe that relationships are everything in business and in life. Founded by two former CEOs of S&P 500 companies and a former presidential press secretary, our premier information service is built for developing relationships that impact decisions in government, business, and media. Utilizing deep research expertise and cutting-edge technology, we help our clients win business and influence policy across various specialties and verticals. We are a close-knit team dedicated to helping each of our users make a difference.
The role anchors a small, three-person client services team, owning the contract administration and renewal workflows that keep every renewal on track while personally managing a book of accounts. This role coordinates renewal and contract processes on behalf of the Account Directors on the team — tracking renewal timelines, keeping renewal tasks moving, and maintaining rigorous Salesforce documentation — and monitors the broader account base for retention risk so nothing slips before it becomes churn.
This role also serves as the personal account manager for a dedicated book of clients. These are largely on-demand accounts that require less outbound engagement and are primarily supported by marketing programs, so the emphasis is on responsive, high-quality client support: renewal conversations, onboarding and training support for client users, and value positioning at renewal time. The role is client-facing, though to a lesser degree than a traditional high-volume account management role.
This role reports into the Revenue Operations team and works closely with Sales Leadership, Client Success, and Finance.

Core Functions of the Role

    • Own contract administration and renewal workflows for the team. Manage the renewal calendar across the team’s accounts; review upcoming renewals and auto-renewals ahead of deadlines; keep the team’s Account Directors on task through each stage of the renewal process; partner with Revenue Operations on contract updates and amendments; and upload executed agreements to SharePoint.
    • Monitor accounts for retention risk.Track engagement and usage signals across the team’s account base, flag churn risk early to the Account Directors and leadership, and partner with Client Success to use client usage patterns to strengthen the business case for renewal.
    • Personally manage a book of on-demand accounts.Serve as account manager for a book of clients who are largely marketing-supported and need less outbound engagement — owning their renewals, auto-renewals, account planning, pricing conversations (including price increases and client pushback), and Salesforce opportunity updates and notes.
    • Provide client onboarding and training support.Deliver onboarding and training support to client users, partnering with Client Success to activate new users within a client license and position product value with client decision-makers.
    • Maintain strong documentation practices.Document all renewal conversations in Salesforce, keep account status, opportunity, and risk transparent to sales leadership, and ensure appropriate client billing contacts with any liaison needed with Finance.
    • Support healthy account practices.Collaborate with Client Success on account hygiene — activating and deactivating users, identifying accounts unassigned to Client Success, and surfacing upsell opportunities within the book.

About You

    • 2+ years of contract administration or renewal management experience (required), ideally in a B2B subscription business model.
    • A background in client success management is a strong plus, though not required.
    • Comfortable keeping others on task — you can coordinate workflows across teammates, track deadlines, and follow up persistently and diplomatically.
    • Detail-oriented documentation practices and strong Salesforce account hygiene that ensure transparency on account status, opportunity, and risk.
    • Client-focused communication skills, including value positioning, handling renewal pushback, and navigating cancel conversations with professionalism.
    • Highly organized, with the ability to manage a personal book of accounts alongside team-wide renewal workflows.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Public Policy, Marketing, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
    • Comfortable working effectively in a remote environment.

What is it like to work here?

We foster an environment that encourages all our team members to excel by offering competitive compensation for top talent. We believe in creating a friendly and enjoyable workplace, with regular team-building events, happy hours, and more. Transparency is key within our company, and we hold weekly town halls led by our CEO to address questions regarding business plans, product direction, and company goals. In addition, we provide flexible PTO policies to ensure you can enjoy your time outside the office and focus on your personal life.
Everyone from full-stack developers to data scientists, former Hill staffers, and sales professionals help shape our in-depth people intelligence.
There is never a dull moment in our Washington, D.C. headquarters. People come from all over the world to join forces at Leadership Connect. We currently have teams working remotely and in-office and often get together for rooftop happy hours, exploring a brand new office, and meeting all the new hires on our growing team.

Want to join our amazing team?

Benefits/Rewards:

Awesome medical insurance plan
Dental Insurance
Life & Disability insurance
Flexible spending accounts
Unlimited PTO!
Eleven Paid Holidays
$3,000 Employee Referral Program
Employer contribution to 401(k) plan
Rewards and recognition programs
If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we still want to hear from you! Leadership Connect is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce where unique experiences are valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute. Research has continuously shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet all of the listed qualifications. We want to help overcome this trend and seek to make space for unique and relevant skills and attributes. So, when applying to Leadership Connect we focus on evaluation based on key competencies needed for success in the position. We look forward to receiving your application!
Leadership Connect is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

About DMI

DMI is a leading provider of digital services and technology solutions, headquartered in Tysons Corner, VA. With a focus on end-to-end managed IT services, including managed mobility, cloud, cybersecurity, network operations, and application development, DMI supports public sector agencies and commercial enterprises around the globe. Recognized as a Top Workplace, DMI is committed to delivering secure, efﬁcient, and cost-effective solutions that drive measurable results. Learn more at www.dminc.com

About the Opportunity

DMI, LLC is seeking a Software Engineer, Level II, a mid-level engineer who analyzes, designs, develops, and implements software solutions on a federal regulatory submission platform, working on both new capabilities and modifications to existing applications. The role participates in all phases of the agency's enterprise performance life cycle and collaborates across development, database, and quality assurance teams to meet rigorous federal delivery standards.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Analyze, design, develop, and implement software solutions across new applications and modifications to existing platform components.
  • Participate in all phases of the agency's enterprise performance life cycle, producing required lifecycle artifacts for each release.
  • Perform software fixes and minor enhancements of under 200 hours against the operations and maintenance backlog.
  • Develop and modify code across Java, PL/SQL, application programming interface, and user interface components of the platform.
  • Execute unit and integration testing, support regression and Section 508 accessibility testing, and remediate defects identified in test or production.
  • Prepare release packages and support coordinated major, minor, and emergency releases with government data center and cloud teams.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, database specialists, and quality assurance analysts to confirm delivered software meets documented requirements.
  • Track and report defects in the government-approved defect tracking application.

Qualifications

Education and Years of Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field. An additional two years of directly relevant software development experience may substitute for the degree.
  • 3 or more years of professional software development experience. The contract's labor category definition describes this level as typically requiring 2 to 4 years of experience.
  • Hands-on development experience in Java, including work with a modern Java Development Kit and an enterprise Java framework.
  • Experience developing and consuming RESTful application programming interfaces.
  • Experience writing and executing unit and integration tests and remediating defects through a formal defect tracking process.
  • Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL or PL/SQL.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Moderate Risk (Tier 2) Public Trust background investigation and a government PIV credential.

Required Skills & Certifications:

  • Experience with Oracle WebLogic, Spring Boot, Hibernate, or Jakarta EE.
  • Front-end development experience with Angular, PrimeFaces, or PrimeNG.
  • Experience with Apache Kafka, Apache Solr, or Apache PDFBox.
  • Prior federal software development experience under a formal lifecycle governance process.
  • Familiarity with Appian or another low-code business process management platform.

Citizenship Status Required: Must be a U.S. Citizen

Physical Requirements: None required for this position.

Location: Remote, US

Minimum Salary Rate

$83,392

Median Salary Rate

$103,000

Working at DMI

DMI is a diverse, prosperous, and rewarding place to work. Our culture is shaped by five core values that guide how we work, grow, and succeed together:

  • Do What’s Right – We lead with honesty and integrity.
  • Own the Outcome – We take responsibility and deliver.
  • Deliver for Our Customers – We are relentless about delivering value.
  • Think Bold, Act Smart – We innovate with purpose.
  • Win Together – We collaborate and celebrate our success.

These values aren’t just ideals—they show up in how we support every part of your well-being:

  • Convenience/Concierge – Virtual health visits, commuter perks, pet insurance, and entertainment discounts that make life easier.
  • Development – Annual performance reviews, tuition assistance, and internal career growth opportunities to help you thrive.
  • Financial – Generous 401(k) matches, life and disability insurance, and financial wellness tools to support your future.
  • Recognition – Annual awards, service anniversaries, referral bonuses, and peer-to-peer shoutouts that spotlight your achievements.
  • Wellness – Healthcare coverage, wellness programs, flu shots, and biometric screenings to support your health.

DMI values employees for their talents and contributions, and we take pride in helping our customers achieve their goals. Because when we live our values, we all win together.

***************** No Agencies Please *****************

We’re looking for a versatile lawyer who gets things done with minimum friction, makes the complex seem simple, and can provide actionable advice to help business teams launch great products for our vibrant community of users. You’ll advise product, engineering, and marketing teams to launch new products that delight our users; untangle the complex web of global regulations that apply to Automattic’s business; and protect free expression and the open web.

Responsibilities:

  • Advise product, engineering, and trust & safety teams on implementation of a broad assortment of regulations and industry standards, with a focus on content safety, consumer protection, intellectual property, privacy, and data security. Familiarity with laws like DSA, the UK and Australian Online Safety Acts, EU AI Act, and worldwide age-assurance laws is a major plus.
  • Provide product counseling on a wide array of products relating to web hosting, site creation, content publication, ecommerce, social media, and more, using a business-forward approach that puts our customers at the center of your analysis.
  • Provide subject matter expertise on data protection and privacy laws, such as GDPR and CCPA, advise on consent frameworks for digital marketing and advertising, and build scalable processes for documenting compliance.
  • Track and prepare for upcoming regulations, and participate in industry groups around the globe, representing Automattic before regulators and advocating for Automattic’s interests before government agencies and officials.
  • Work with trust & safety teams to develop and oversee policies championing freedom of expression and user safety while complying with applicable laws.
  • Design processes and workflows that enable the legal team to effectively scale compliance in a manner that meets the increase in regulatory and privacy requirements.

Requirements:

  • JD from a US accredited law school with 5+ years of relevant experience (or an exception EU-based attorney)
  • Familiarity with the industries, concepts, and business models relevant to Automattic’s products (e.g., open source, user-generated content, web hosting, social media, ecommerce, and digital advertising) and the product, privacy, and regulatory requirements that apply to them.
  • Humble and eager teammate who is also able to function independently and work in an asynchronous environment, with a willingness and ability to stretch into new areas like litigation or IP if needed.
  • Be comfortable in the grey areas, and have the ability to provide recommendations and offer clear thinking even with imperfect information.

We are hiring at either the Counsel or Senior Counsel level, and we encourage candidates across both levels to apply. Title, compensation, and the scope of independent ownership over the matters described above will reflect the experience and qualifications a candidate brings to the role.

Compensation and Benefits

We are currently prioritizing candidates who reside in the United States or Europe.

Salary range: $180,000 - $300,000 USD. Please note that salary ranges are global, regardless of location, and we pay in local currency.

We are searching for high-caliber candidates with the skills and qualities to have a net positive for Automattic. Pay will reflect the potential contribution and the impact you can bring, which may, in some cases, go beyond the range stated.

This isn’t your typical work-from-home job; we are a fully-remote company with an open vacation policy. Read more about our compensation philosophy. To see a full list of benefits by country, consult our Benefits Page. And check out these links to learn more about How We Hire and What We Expect from Ourselves.

About Automattic

Now in our 20th year, we’re the people behind , WooCommerce, Beeper, Tumblr, Simplenote, Jetpack, Longreads, Day One, PocketCasts, and more. We believe in making the web a better place.

We’re a distributed company with more than 1500 Automatticians in nearly every corner of the globe, speaking over a hundred different languages. Enriched by this diversity, we’re united by a singular mission: to democratize publishing, commerce, and messaging so anyone with a story can tell it, anyone with a product can sell it, and everyone can manage their communications from a single source. In short, we help maintain a balance in society, creating and continually refining powerful tools people can use to compete fairly—regardless of income, gender, politics, language, or where they live in the world.

We believe in Open Source, and the vast majority of our work is available under the GPL. Automattic is a Most Loved Company, an Equal Opportunity employer, and Disability Confident Committed. (Here’s what that might mean for you.) If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please fill out this form. We are committed to ensuring an accessible hiring process for all candidates. Learn more about our Employee Resource Groups.

You can track your application status and more at MyGreenhouse.

To learn about how we handle your data, please review our Job Applicant & Candidate Privacy Notice and our Privacy Policy.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Tiger Analytics is looking for experienced Data Analyst/Business Analyst to join our fast-growing advanced analytics consulting firm. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning and AI. We are the trusted analytics partner for multiple Fortune 500 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner. We are looking for top-notch talent as we continue to build the best global analytics consulting team in the world.

The Business Analyst, Process Improvement is responsible for improving and simplifying New Product Setup (NPS) workstreams within Appian. This role focuses on workflow simplification, field usage and governance, and standardization across regions and ERPs. The role partners closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and process owners to improve current-state processes within Appian. The role will initially focus on NPS and may expand to support additional processes over time.

Responsibilities:

  • Support future-state process design for NPS workstreams adopted by Appian
  • Identify opportunities to simplify workflows and eliminate inefficient current-state process steps
  • Drive field rationalization and improve field usage and governance across workstreams
  • Develop recommendations to standardize processes across regions and ERPs where appropriate
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand current-state pain points and improvement opportunities
  • Help document ways of working that support more consistent and scalable process execution
  • Collaborate with product owners to ensure process improvements are reflected in backlog and delivery planning
  • Support cross-functional working sessions to align on process changes and simplification opportunities
  • Help reduce downstream rework by improving process clarity and consistency before development begins

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 5+ years’ experience in business process improvement, process design, operational transformation, or a similar role
  • 5+ years’ experience simplifying workflows and improving business processes in complex environments
  • Experience working across multiple stakeholder groups to identify pain points and translate them into practical process improvements
  • Experience working in agile environments and supporting requirements readiness for iterative delivery
  • Experience supporting cross-functional business process initiatives preferred
  • Experience with regional or multi-ERP process standardization preferred
  • Experience with master data, product setup, or enterprise workflow processes
  • Familiarity with structured process improvement methodologies or continuous improvement practices

Skills:

  • Workflow simplification and process improvement
  • Field rationalization and field governance support
  • Cross-functional facilitation and stakeholder coordination
  • Process documentation and ways-of-working development
  • Analytical problem solving
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Ability to identify inefficiencies and recommend practical improvements
  • Ability to work effectively across business teams and operational functions
  • Strong organizational and issue management skills

Benefits

Significant career development opportunities exist as the company grows. The position offers a unique opportunity to be part of a small, fast-growing, challenging and entrepreneurial environment, with a high degree of individual responsibility.

raw.description:
Le ou la Chef.fe de Produit traduit la stratégie produit et les priorités de la feuille de route en travaux clairs et réalisables pour les équipes de développement, tout en maximisant la valeur livrée à chaque version et à chaque sprint. Il s’agit d’un rôle tactique axé sur l’exécution : la personne titulaire du poste est responsable du backlog pour un domaine fonctionnel défini, collabore quotidiennement avec les équipes de développement et de conception, et veille à ce que les fonctionnalités développées répondent aux besoins les plus importants des clients et de l’entreprise.

Agissant comme principal point de liaison entre la vision du gestionnaire de produit et l’exécution de l’équipe de développement, le ou la propriétaire de produit combine une solide connaissance du domaine produit à une expérience pratique de la livraison agile. La réussite dans ce rôle repose sur un jugement solide au quotidien et sur la capacité à prendre des décisions éclairées quant aux compromis nécessaires afin de maintenir l’alignement avec la stratégie produit définie par la gestion de produits et les dirigeants de l’entreprise.

Principales responsabilités

  • Assurer la gestion et la priorisation du carnet de produit pour un domaine produit assigné, en rédigeant des user stories clairs ainsi que des critères d’acceptation qui traduisent les thèmes de la feuille de route et les exigences des clients en travaux concrets pour les équipes de développement.
  • Collaborer quotidiennement avec les équipes de développement et de conception tout au long du cycle de développement, notamment lors des activités de raffinement, de planification des sprints, des rencontres quotidiennes, des revues et des rétrospectives. Prendre rapidement des décisions concernant la portée, l’ordre de mise en œuvre et les priorités, et transmettre les compromis de nature stratégique ou financière au gestionnaire de produit ou au directeur, au besoin.
  • Valider que les fonctionnalités livrées répondent aux critères d’acceptation et aux résultats attendus pour les clients ou l’entreprise. Agir comme principal point de contact auprès de l’équipe de développement pour les questions liées aux exigences, à l’intention fonctionnelle et aux priorités.
  • Recueillir et synthétiser les commentaires provenant des équipes des ventes, du succès client, du soutien technique et des clients afin d’alimenter l’évolution du carnet de produit. Soutenir également le gestionnaire de produit dans les activités de recherche de marché, d’analyse concurrentielle et de définition des exigences fonctionnelles.
  • Effectuer le suivi et la production de rapports sur l’avancement des sprints et des versions, la vélocité ainsi que les indicateurs de livraison. Identifier de façon proactive les risques liés à la portée ou aux échéanciers et intégrer les commentaires issus des tests d’acceptation utilisateurs et des programmes bêta aux prochaines itérations du carnet de produit.

Qualifications et expérience

  • Baccalauréat en génie, en administration, en technologie ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente.
  • De 2 à 4 ans d’expérience à titre de chef.fe/responsable de produit, d’analyste d’affaires ou dans un rôle similaire lié à la livraison agile ou à la gestion de produits au sein d’une entreprise de logiciels.
  • Connaissance pratique des méthodologies Agile/Scrum et expérience concrète avec des outils de gestion des carnets de produit et des sprints tels que Jira ou Azure DevOps.
  • Capacité démontrée à traduire une orientation stratégique et les besoins de la clientèle en récits utilisateurs clairs et en critères d’acceptation précis.
  • Expérience de collaboration directe avec des équipes de développement et aisance à mener des discussions techniques portant sur la faisabilité, l’ordre de réalisation et les compromis.
  • Excellentes compétences analytiques et en résolution de problèmes, avec une grande attention aux détails dans la définition des exigences et la validation de la qualité.
  • Bonne compréhension des technologies infonuagiques, SaaS et des plateformes d’entreprise à grande échelle.

Qualifications privilégiées et exigences particulières

  • Expérience dans le domaine des technologies de l’information en santé.
  • Capacité démontrée à exercer un leadership d’influence plutôt que d’autorité.
  • Excellentes habiletés en communication et en organisation, avec un historique démontré de collaboration entre les équipes de développement, de conception et les partenaires d’affaires interfonctionnels.

La présente description de poste ne constitue pas une liste exhaustive des tâches ou des exigences. Intelerad se réserve le droit de la modifier en tout temps.

Le salaire de base pour ce poste varie entre $71,250/yr - 95,000/yr CAD Le salaire peut varier en fonction des connaissances, des compétences et de l'expérience liées au poste. Intelerad est une entreprise qui offre une rémunération globale. Le salaire dépend du poste proposé. Des bonus et d'autres formes de rémunération peuvent être accordés dans le cadre d'un programme de rémunération globale, en plus d'une gamme complète d'avantages sociaux médicaux, financiers, de retraite, de congés payés et/ou autres.

Tous les candidats répondant aux qualifications minimales devront effectuer une évaluation en ligne de 30 minutes dans le cadre de leur candidature.

Tous vos renseignements seront gardés confidentiels conformément aux lignes directrices de l'EEO.

Intelerad is committed to the principles of equal employment. We are committed to complying with all federal, state and local laws providing equal employment opportunities and all other employment laws and regulations. Applicants, employees and former employees are protected from employment discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age , disability and genetic information (including family medical history). Intelerad is dedicated to the fulfillment of this policy regarding all aspects of employment, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, placement, transfer, training, promotion, rates of pay, and other compensation, termination, and all other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment.

 

Intelerad is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity for qualified individuals with disabilities. Intelerad uses the Americans with Disabilities Act (“ADA”)as a standard for global recruiting and hiring purposes. This prohibits discrimination against qualified individuals with disabilities. The ADA defines “disability” as a physical or mental impairment that substantially limits one or more of the major life activities of an individual, a record of such impairment, or being regarded as having such an impairment

Chez Intelerad, nous croyons que le chemin vers les réponses en matière de soins de santé doit être clair, que vous attendiez un diagnostic ou que vous essayiez d'en accélérer un. Nos solutions d’imagerie médicale rationalisent le flux d’informations, simplifient les processus complexes, maximisent l’efficacité et mettent en lumière l’inconnu. Nous permettons aux médecins d'apporter aux patients les réponses dont ils ont besoin plus rapidement et d'améliorer les résultats pour tous. Grâce à une imagerie plus accessible, on sort les patients de l’obscurité.

Basée à Raleigh, en Caroline du Nord, et à Montréal, Intelerad compte près de 800 employés dans des bureaux répartis dans quatre pays. L'entreprise offre à près de 2 000 organisations de soins de santé à travers le monde la rapidité, l'évolutivité et la simplicité nécessaires pour augmenter les performances de l'entreprise tout en, surtout, en améliorant les résultats des patients. Les solutions d'entreprise modernes d'Intelerad ont été récompensées par le prix « Best in KLAS », se classant à la première place dans la catégorie « PACS Europe (UK/Irlande) » du rapport « Best in KLAS : Global Software (Non-US) » de 2026.
