raw.description:
DATA ANALYST

Department: Finance and Administration

JOB SUMMARY

One More Child is seeking to employ a full-time Data Analyst to support its mission of impacting vulnerable children and struggling families through the collection, integration, analysis, forecasting, and visualization of organizational data. The Data Analyst will bridge the gap between raw data and actionable intelligence by leveraging Microsoft Fabric's unified analytics platform to transform data into strategic insights that improve decision-making across fundraising, finance, program operations, and organizational leadership.

This position will be responsible for analyzing data from multiple sources, developing semantic data models, identifying trends and opportunities, conducting predictive analysis, and delivering interactive Power BI dashboards that translate data into meaningful business insights. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, advanced Microsoft Fabric and Power BI expertise, and the ability to communicate complex data findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS

  • Design and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, and scorecards using Power BI
  • Monitor Fabric data pipelines and datasets and extend semantic models.
  • Perform trend analysis, forecasting, and predictive analytics to support organizational planning and decision-making.
  • Maintain reliable reporting systems that include data from multiple legacy organizational systems and new data systems as needed; identify inaccurate or inconsistent data and work with appropriate departments to cleanse data and resolve underlying issues.
  • Utilize SQL, Power BI, and Fabric analytics tools to identify insights, opportunities, risks, and performance trends.
  • Develop and support machine learning and predictive models using Microsoft Fabric Data Science tools, Spark and/or Python.
  • Maintain and respond to automated monitoring, alerts, and reporting solutions using Microsoft Fabric capabilities.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to define reporting requirements, KPIs, and analytical needs.
  • Develop report wireframes, mockups, or prototypes to validate layout, metrics, filters, and user experience prior to dashboard development.
  • Present data-driven recommendations and insights to leadership and department teams.
  • Support data governance, data quality, security, and reporting best practices across the organization.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • N/A


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three (3) or more years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, data modeling, and dashboard development.
  • Ability to demonstrate data visualization capabilities in Power BI and provide examples of previous dashboard, report, or analytics work.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, and Data Warehouse.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience querying large datasets.
  • Working knowledge of Python, Spark, or other data science and analytics tools.
  • Knowledge of dimensional modeling, forecasting, statistical analysis, and predictive analytics methodologies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to present technical information to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain data accuracy, and work effectively in a collaborative environment.
  • Preferred certifications: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Power BI Data Analyst Associate, Certified Analytics Professional or similar.
  • Preferred KQL experience

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • N/A

COMPETENCIES

  • Present oneself, both at and outside of work, in a manner keeping with One More Child’s Core Values of Humble, Hungry, Wise, and Called.
  • Ability to solve day-to-day problems by analyzing issues and determining next steps.
  • Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to follow instructions, meet deadlines, and work independently.
  • Commitment to ongoing skill development and learning.

SPIRITUAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • It is the mission of One More Child to provide Christ-centered services to vulnerable children and struggling families. As stated in the Second Amended and Restated Articles of Incorporation, One More Child provides these services in a Christian context consistent with The Baptist Faith and Message (2000). Employees of One More Child commit to live in a manner that is not contrary to this foundational statement of faith.
  • Have had a personal conversion experience with Jesus Christ and been scripturally baptized.
  • Possess a sense of commitment to ministry through vocation.
  • Hold a sincere desire to seek God and His kingdom.
  • Demonstrate personal and devotional habits and practices such as Bible study, prayer, and daily meditation.
  • Be a member of a New Testament, evangelical church in the local community and attend regularly.
  • Engage in witness activities as a normal part of life.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

These physical requirements are not exhaustive, and One More Child may add additional job-related physical demands to these if the need arises. Corrective devices may be used to meet these physical requirements.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee is occasionally required to walk and reach with hands and arms. The employee must be able to operate a forklift. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

This job requires the ability to work in stressful conditions from time to time and remain focused for extended periods of time. The ability to lift up to 30 pounds (boxes, documents, and/or equipment) may be required on occasion.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment describes the conditions that an employee may encounter when performing their job duties, including but not limited to, the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodation may be available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these duties.

Job functions are performed in both normal office environments.

DISCLAIMER

This job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of the requirements of this position, but to describe the general nature of the job and provide a reasonable representation of its activities. Additional related work may be identified and assigned by the organization and included as an area of responsibility while assessing performance.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

One More Child is committed to a workplace environment that encourages growth and respect for all current and prospective employees based upon job-related factors such as their educational background, work experience, and ability to perform the essential functions of a particular job. It is the policy and practice of One More Child to prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment based on statuses protected under federal, state, or local laws which are applicable to the organization. Reporting to: AD, Knowledge Management
Compensation: $82K - $104K CAD
Employment Type: Full Time
Location: Remote - Canada (Candidates based in British Columbia, Alberta, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Nova Scotia or willing to relocate)
Who We Are:
World Education Services (WES) is a non-profit social enterprise that supports the educational, economic, and social inclusion of immigrants, refugees, and international students. For 50 years, WES has set the standard for international academic credential evaluation, supporting millions of people as they seek to achieve their academic and professional goals. Through decades of experience as a leader in global education, WES has developed a wide range of tools to pursue social impact at scale. From evaluating academic credentials to shaping policy, designing programs, and providing philanthropic funding, we partner with a diverse set of organizations, leaders, and networks to uplift individuals and drive systems change. Together with its partners, WES enables people to learn, work, and thrive in new places. For more information about WES, please visit our website at www.WES.org.
About the Opportunity:

The Training and Instructional Design Specialist is part of the Knowledge Management and Optimization team within the Business Division and supports the development of high-quality learning solutions across a range of formats. This role focuses on delivering virtual instructor-led and hybrid training, and on creating training materials for instructor-led, hybrid, and e-learning formats. The Training and Instructional Design Specialist works closely with subject matter experts to translate complex policy, business processes, and technical information into clear, engaging, learner-centered experiences. The role applies core instructional design principles, including adult learning theory, ADDIE, and assessment best practices, in day-to-day work to efficiently develop, manage, and enhance training content

What You'll Do:
  • Develop and deliver training materials for e-learning, hybrid, and instructor-led sessions as well as job aids, training videos, and other training deliverables
  • Prepare training materials, learning environments, and participant resources to support effective learning experiences for complex policy, operational, and technical content
  • Reinforce learner understanding through coaching, follow-up support, and responding to learner questions
  • Create and update knowledge checks, quizzes, and learner activities
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts to continuously update and improve training materials based on business changes, learner feedback, and evaluation results
  • Support LMS administration activities, including course setup, learner communications, completion tracking, and reporting
  • Measure training effectiveness and business outcomes with a view to continuous improvement
Your Experience:
  • Bachelor’s degree in related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 3-5 years of experience in instructional design and training in a corporate, technical, or operational training environment, with direct responsibility for building and delivering training content
  • Instructional Design/training qualification/certification (e.g. ATD APTD)
  • Demonstrated application of instructional design principles, including adult learning theory, ADDIE, assessment design, and basic training measurement and evaluation
  • Hands-on experience developing e-learning modules using Articulate (Storyline and Rise)
  • Expertise in creating a range of training deliverables, including e-learning, instructor-led materials, job aids, and presentations
  • Proven ability to translate complex policy, business processes, or technical information into clear, engaging learning content
  • Experience working with SMEs and stakeholders to gather, refine, and validate training content
  • Proven ability to use AI-supported tools to support efficient workflows
  • Experience working with a Learning Management System (LMS) to upload, organize, and maintain training content, and for reporting
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deliverables in a fast-paced environment while maintaining quality and consistency
  • Bring a “can-do” attitude, have a willingness to stretch up and down in role, take on additional responsibilities, and quickly establish credibility in new areas of work.
  • Build collaborative, trust-based working relationships to contribute towards collective goals.
  • Demonstrate an entrepreneurial mindset to generate new approaches, spot innovative opportunities, take calculated risks, and initiate action.
  • Thrive in an environment that values transparency, accountability, collaboration, and an orientation for results.
  • Possess intellectual curiosity, an openness to diverse ideas and perspectives, and a continued interest in learning, professional growth and development.

Desired

  • Experience with AI-based video or voiceover tools (e.g., Synthesia, Vyond, WellSaid Labs or similar)
What We Offer:
Joining our team at WES means embarking on a purpose-driven career with a global impact, where you contribute daily to making a tangible difference in the lives of people worldwide. You'll thrive in an employee-centric environment, with access to learning opportunities, pathways for personal and professional development, and recognition of your achievements. Our inclusive, mission-driven culture values employees and focuses on investing in our people through our culture, people framework, and programming while offering the flexibility of remote work options.
  • Work-Life Harmony: We believe that success is all about maintaining balance. Enjoy the freedom of remote work and flexible scheduling, paired with generous time-off policies designed to assist you in maintaining a healthy equilibrium between your personal and professional commitments. Our comprehensive wellness programs and work environment are focused on fostering your well-being.
  • Rewards and Recognition: Your dedication and achievements are the cornerstone of our success. We recognize the importance of valuing your hard work which is why we offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and tangible rewards to celebrate your contributions.
  • Professional Growth and Development: We are committed to nurturing growth within our team, recognizing that growth is essential to providing opportunities for career advancement and ongoing professional development. To prioritize your learning and success, we invest in comprehensive training programs and offer tuition reimbursement opportunities. We promote a culture of continuous learning that empowers you to thrive and evolve in your career.
  • Innovation and Impact: Engage in work that directly transforms lives and empowers individuals and communities by expanding access to global educational and professional pathways. Join us in fostering a culture that values innovation, embraces new approaches, and leverages transformation to implement and drive impactful change.
  • Community and Connection: Our team is made up of individuals from different cultures and backgrounds who have varying perspectives and ideas. Our diverse workforce reflects the global community we serve, and we take pride in it. We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. Experience the power of connection by participating in a range of activities, including employee-led resource groups, town halls, collaborative team events, meaningful volunteer opportunities, and initiatives that promote equity, celebrate diversity, and cultivate a strong sense of belonging within our organization.
Values:
    • Opportunity - We open doors so people can build better futures.
    • Inclusion - We become stronger, more creative, and more resilient when we embrace diversity.
    • Equity - We uphold fairness and justice in our work and actions.
    • Enterprising - We are resourceful, inventive, and driven.
    • Expertise - We challenge ourselves to be the best at what we do.
Inclusive Recruitment Process:
We welcome all applicants, irrespective of their experience perfectly fitting the job description, as we value diverse and innovative viewpoints. At our organization, individuals who thrive in a culture of continuous learning and inclusive teamwork excel. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply.
Our Commitment:
At World Education Services, we're committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that reflects the rich tapestry of our communities, both in the US and Canada. This commitment is underscored by our unwavering dedication to providing equal opportunities to all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or genetics. This commitment extends to every aspect of employment, from recruitment and hiring to promotions, training, and benefits. We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. For us, diversity goes beyond compliance – it's about embracing unique perspectives and cultivating an environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential.
If you encounter challenges accessing or using our career site due to a disability, you may request reasonable accommodation by contacting us via email . Our Talent Acquisition team is dedicated to supporting qualified candidates by providing solutions that can meet their needs.
Please be advised that this email address is intended to receive and respond to inquiries concerning the accessibility of the online application system, and requests for assistance and accommodation during any part of the recruitment process. Résumés or applications sent to this email address will not be reviewed.
For more information about WES, please visit our website at.

raw.description:
Zencore is a premier Google Cloud pure-play consultancy and a four-time Google Cloud Partner of the Year. Founded by former Google Cloud leaders and engineers, we specialize in helping enterprises modernize infrastructure, architect modern data platforms, and deploy production-ready AI frameworks.

With private equity backing from Superstep Capital and a rapidly expanding global footprint across North America, LATAM, and EMEA, Zencore combines the technical depth of a large GSI with the agility, senior talent, and execution speed of an elite boutique.

About this role

    We are seeking a commercial strategist, former Enterprise Account Executive, or field-tested sales leader who understands how enterprise tech deals actually get closed. In this role, you will act as the chief orchestrator between Zencore’s sales/technical teams and Google Cloud’s enterprise sales organization.

    You know how Google Cloud AEs, Regional Directors, and Technical Account Managers think because you’ve sat in the commercial trenches. You understand field quotas, SPIFs, consumption commitments, and how to position Zencore as the essential delivery partner that helps Google reps hit their numbers. Your primary mandate is simple: accelerate pipeline creation, drive joint co-sell revenue, elevate Zencore's brand visibility with Google partner leadership, and secure priority access to strategic partner programs and designations across the ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Drive Commercial Co-Selling: Partner directly with Zencore Enterprise AEs and Google Cloud sales reps to map strategic target accounts, shape opportunities, and orchestrate joint account planning across Enterprise and Select verticals.

  • Champion Brand Visibility with Partner Leadership: Work hand-in-hand with Google Cloud Partner Development Managers (PDMs), Partner Sales Directors, and Ecosystem Executives to maximize Zencore's brand prominence across internal Google sales channels, regional field showcases, and executive forums.

  • Secure Priority Program Access & Resources: Serve as the chief advocate for Zencore within Google Partner Advantage—securing early access to strategic partner programs, elite specializations, product betas, and maximum drawdown of funding programs (RAMP, Partner Marketing Funds, proof-of-concept credits).

  • Unlock Google Field Incentives: Deploy Google Cloud funding programs to subsidize client engagements, eliminate buyer friction, and close enterprise SOWs faster.

  • Orchestrate High-Impact QBRs: Lead business reviews with Google partner leadership, delivering clear, data-driven narrative updates on co-sell performance, win rates, and joint pipeline growth.

  • Pipeline Precision & Health: Ensure 100% accuracy in partner pipeline reporting, deal registration, and attribution within Google Partner Advantage, framing operational updates around business metrics rather than administrative tasks.

Qualifications

  • Commercial / Sales Background: 5–8+ years in Enterprise Software Sales, Solution Sales, Commercial BD, or Strategic Account Management within the cloud/IT services space. Direct experience carrying a quota or leading commercial deal strategy is strongly preferred over pure administrative alliance experience.

  • Deep Google Cloud Ecosystem Fluency: Comprehensive understanding of Google Cloud’s organization, sales segments, field incentive structures, and partner programs. You know how field reps get paid, how co-selling works in practice, and how to navigate Google partner leadership to secure elite program access.

  • Partner Advocacy & Gravitas: Ability to command a room with enterprise executives, Google Regional Directors, and Partner Leadership. You speak the language of business value, ROI, and mutual ecosystem growth.

  • High-Energy Execution: A "make-things-happen" operator who thrives in a fast-paced, PE-backed environment and naturally takes ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

  • Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to align internal technical delivery leads, external partner reps, and marketing teams behind a unified commercial campaign.

What success looks like

  • Measurable Revenue Impact: Consistent, predictable growth in Zencore-sourced and co-sold revenue attached to Google Cloud.

  • First-Call Partner Status: Google Cloud sales reps actively bringing Zencore into pre-commit enterprise accounts before competitor consultancies are even notified.

  • Elevated Brand & Program Standing: Recognized as an elite Google partner with priority access to top-tier funding programs, beta initiatives, and prominent brand visibility across Google Cloud's internal sales channels.

  • High Conversion Rates: Faster deal cycles and higher win rates driven by strategic deployment of Google funding programs (RAMP/MDF).

  • Robust Executive Alignment: Deep, durable relationships with Google Cloud regional sales and partner leaders that yield consistent multi-year deal flow.

Why work at Zencore?

  • We Are Trusted Experts: Our teams bring deep, hands-on experience to solve the hardest cloud and AI challenges.

  • We Value Candor: We share unbiased opinions and aren't afraid of hard truths—our clients view us as true subject matter experts.

  • We Are the Missing Link: We connect our enterprise clients directly to Google Cloud innovation, moving with agility where larger consultancies stall out.

  • We Remove Uncertainty: We bring structured playbooks that eliminate risk from complex cloud migrations and AI deployments.

  • We Show Empathy: We build lasting client trust because we understand the real-world operational complexities of enterprise technology.

Zencore is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Zencore is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”

Senior Java Engineer

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Java Engineer to join our team and play a key role in building, modernizing, and enhancing a critical enterprise Master Data Platform. This platform serves as the source for maintaining key demographic data and delivering robust data management capabilities across customers, bankers, and related entities.

As part of this team, you will contribute to the design and development of scalable, high-performance backend services that ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across the organization. You will work on complex integration challenges, enabling seamless data exchange between systems while adhering to strict security, privacy, and regulatory standards.

Your work will directly support operational efficiency, regulatory reporting, risk management, and customer experience initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop high-performance applications using Java.
  • Work with GraphDB and Scala-based components to manage complex data relationships and processing.
  • Support big data systems operating at scale with continuous, real-time data processing.
  • Build and optimize systems for transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and fraud detection.
  • Ensure platform reliability, scalability, and performance for business-critical workloads.

Requirements:

  • Exposure to big data technologies and distributed processing.
  • High level of Java (Concurrency, JVM, JMM); Experience building streaming data architectures;
  • Good working knowledge of Data Meshe, Data Lakes and warehousing solutions;
  • Strong experience with Kubernetes, building Kubernetes operators is of special interest;
  • Experience with message brokers (Kafka/ RabbitMQ);

Nice to have:

  • Practical experience with messaging system (Kafka, Solace, *MQ).
  • Experience with Graph databases (GraphDB) and Scala.
  • Docker experience. OpenShift\Public cloud experience.
  • Experience with Java profiling\troubleshooting. Experience with Mongo. Knowledge of FX Risk calculations
  • Understanding of data governance, master data management, and real-time processing systems.
  • Ability to work on highly critical, large-scale enterprise platforms.

This role is central to maintaining a mission-critical platform that enables secure, compliant, and scalable business operations.

Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus

raw.description:
A World-Changing Company at Lifebit

At Lifebit, we're driven by the mission to make sensitive patient data securely accessible for biomedical researchers, and to enable complex AI-driven analysis in a simple, intuitive, and reproducible way. We empower leading institutions & researchers worldwide through our pioneering federated platform for population-scale health and life sciences, which uniquely enables secure cross-institution data discovery & analysis while keeping sensitive health data securely in place. Our Federated AI Platform is trusted by the world’s largest precision medicine programmes, health systems, global pharma, CROs, academic institutions, and biobanks, spanning the UK, Europe, US, Canada, Japan, Singapore, and more.

As we scale past our Series B phase, we are expanding our organization to meet the rapidly growing demand of a global market. Join us if you're inspired to tackle a mission that matters and want to lead the next generation of AI-based biomedical research solutions.

The Role

Lifebit is launching a new AI product line and is hiring an AI Product Lead to own it end to end. You will set the product strategy and roadmap, lead product marketing and positioning, and build the product hands-on with our engineering team. This is a foundational role with direct influence over what we build, who we build it for and how it reaches the market.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own product strategy and roadmap for a new enterprise AI product line
  • Build the product with the engineering team, from discovery through shipping and iteration
  • Own product marketing: positioning, messaging and launch execution
  • Hire exceptional new team members into the product organisation as the unit scales
  • Translate the needs of scientific users into product decisions, working directly with customers
  • Report directly to the CEO on product progress and adoption

What You Bring to the Table

  • 5 to 15 years of product experience
  • A biomedical background (biology, computational biology, genetics or a related discipline); this is a requirement. You understand science at the level of a working scientist and can engage credibly with biomedical and genetic researchers
  • Shipped products to a biomedical scientist user base; this is a firm requirement
  • Deep familiarity with AI/ML product development and the current LLM ecosystem
  • A track record of working directly with engineering teams to build and ship, not only to specify
  • Strong product marketing instincts, able to position technical products for enterprise buyers

Preferred Qualifications

  • Biomedical research acumen: Experience in genetics, biomedical research, or Bioinformatics is a significant plus, but a passion for the field is essential.

What We Offer

Lifebit is synonymous with a dynamic work culture that encourages both personal and professional growth. Our mission-driven organization is dedicated to making a significant impact in science and healthcare. We provide a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Compensation: Competitive salary, performance-based bonus and equity.
  • AI Upskilling: Use up to £10,000 and 10 dedicated days per year for qualified AI-related professional development (AI certification, LLM workshop, or AI bootcamp).
  • Professional Development & Wellbeing: An annual personal development budget of £1,000 for conferences, training, certifications and personal wellbeing.
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from anywhere in the UK with a home-office stipend. In accordance with 2026 UK employment reforms, we provide Day One access to paternity and unpaid parental leave.
  • Flexible Working: Receive 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays and flexible hours to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  • Extra Time Off for parents: Two additional days of annual leave to support your family.
  • Diverse Team: Join an international and diverse team passionate about transforming healthcare through data.
  • Deep Technology & Science: Get exposure to problems and applications in the cloud, data analysis, ML, life sciences, and big data fields.

Join us at Lifebit for a career that promises to be your next significant venture, dedicated to advancing the scientific and healthcare fields. Don't miss the chance to be part of our mission!

Life at Lifebit

Lifebit is dedicated to fostering an environment where employees can flourish, valuing individual strengths, skills, and passions. We prioritize health and well-being, offering comprehensive benefits and support. Our fully remote model is built on trust and asynchronous communication, utilizing virtual workshops and occasional off-sites to maximize creativity and innovation.

Lifebit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment. In compliance with the UK Employment Rights Act and Fair Work Agency guidelines, we ensure transparent pay structures and robust data privacy for all staff.

Compliance & Eligibility

All applicants must have the right to work in the UK. This role is subject to a standard Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check given the sensitive nature of the medical data platforms we manage.

Join us in reshaping the future of health data analysis and technology integration.

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

The Affirm Card is one of the company's fastest-growing products and an increasingly significant contributor to overall platform GMV. Our team owns everything that happens after a card transaction settles. We build and operate the systems that keep customer accounts accurate and resolve issues when something goes wrong after a transaction, working closely with the teams that own card issuing, transaction processing, and money movement.

As Affirm continues to expand its card offerings, the volume and complexity of post-transaction interaction continues to grow. You will work on systems that directly determine whether customers get accurate resolutions and timely communications after a card transaction, collaborating closely with product, compliance, and cross-functional partner teams. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the customer-facing outcomes of one of Affirm's most strategic and fastest-growing products while solving complex engineering challenges at scale.

What You'll Do

  • With the support of your team’s tech lead and manager, you will break down larger projects into individual tasks, deliver them in multiple phases, and collaborate with others to ensure timely delivery of your work.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
  • You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process.

What We Look For

  • You have a total of 1.5+ years of experience as a software engineer.
  • You have experience designing, developing and launching backend systems and are proficient in one of Python or Kotlin.
  • You are familiar with the building blocks of distributed systems, and the technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
  • You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
  • You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - USA 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $128,000 - $188,000 CAD

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

  • Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
  • Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
  • ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount

We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.

[For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

raw.description:
*This is a complete remote position based in India. Candidate must be available for rotational Shift based on the business requirements. *

Company Overview:
Talent Systems, LLC is the leading technology solution provider for casting and auditioning to the entertainment industry. Casting directors and agents worldwide use Talent Systems’ portfolio of products to source and manage talent across film, television, commercials, theater, and digital projects, powering an unparalleled, global casting software ecosystem.

We are headquartered in Los Angeles and operate in the US, Canada, Mexico, UK, Australia, and India. Our portfolio brands include Casting Networks, Spotlight, Cast It Systems, Staff Me Up, Tagmin, Casting Frontier, and Cast It Reach.

Team Overview:
The Talent Systems Support team delivers responsive, knowledgeable, and high-quality support for customers across the globe. With team members distributed across North America, Latin America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, we work together to resolve issues, share insights, and ensure a consistent experience across all Talent Systems platforms.

Job Purpose:
Voice Support Specialists deliver high-quality, efficient support to our global customers. This includes answering product questions, guiding customers through features and workflows, and resolving technical issues. Rather than just answering the immediate question, Specialists aim to understand the root of each inquiry and recommend the best solution or workflow.

Excellent communication and problem-solving are essential to this role — both in writing and on the phone. In addition to handling the full range of day-to-day support requests, Voice Support Specialists are equipped to take on escalated or complex cases that are better suited to a live conversation.

In addition to resolving individual tickets, Specialists help identify recurring issues and surface product feedback to the broader team — helping us continuously improve our products and the overall customer experience.

This role is based in India and requires confident, fluent spoken English and familiarity with the communication norms and expectations of global, primarily Western, customers.

Responsibilities

  • Respond to customer questions via email and chat (and occasionally text) in a timely, thoughtful, and clear manner
  • Troubleshoot technical issues and see them through to resolution, escalating bugs or complex problems when needed
  • Guide customers through product features and workflows to help them achieve their goals
  • Handle escalated or complex cases that benefit from live phone interaction
  • De-escalate difficult or emotionally charged customer interactions with calm, empathy, and professionalism
  • Capture and share product feedback, pain points, and recurring issues
  • Keep internal records up to date with helpful notes, known issues, and troubleshooting steps
  • Contribute to team goals by managing a high volume of support requests without sacrificing quality
  • Stay current on new product updates and communicate changes to customers as needed
  • Build deep product knowledge across all Talent Systems tools

Requirements

  • Excellent communication skills — clear, conversational, and helpful — with the ability to work effectively with people from diverse countries, backgrounds, and cultures
  • Fluent spoken English with confident verbal communication skills; familiarity with Western business communication norms is important in this role
  • Demonstrated experience in voice or phone-based customer support required
  • High emotional intelligence: ability to read customer tone, manage difficult conversations, and remain composed during live interactions
  • Strong customer support experience, ideally in a high-volume email or chat-based environment
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable troubleshooting issues across cloud-based tools and systems
  • Experience with help desk platforms and CRMs (e.g., Zendesk, JIRA)
  • Familiarity with the entertainment industry or experience supporting video/media tools is a plus
  • Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple conversations and competing priorities
  • Comfortable working independently, using sound judgment, and asking for help when needed
  • Graduation degree is a must

raw.description:
Enterprise Sales Executive – Digital Asset Platform (APEX & Treasury)

About AlphaPoint

AlphaPoint is the infrastructure platform behind digital asset businesses worldwide. Since 2013, we have powered exchanges, brokerages, banks, and fintechs across dozens of countries, giving them the trading, custody connectivity, tokenization, treasury, and settlement capabilities they need to operate in digital assets at institutional scale.

We are not a collection of products in a box. AlphaPoint is a single platform with many capabilities: one integration that lets a client offer trading, brokerage, treasury, and stablecoin workflows to their end users, connect to the liquidity venues, custodians, and banking partners of their choice, and expand into new use cases without re-platforming. Every super app needs a super platform underneath it. That is what we build.

About the Role

We are hiring a Sales Executive to open new markets for the AlphaPoint platform, with APEX (our trading and brokerage infrastructure) and APEX Treasury (our treasury and settlement layer) as the lead offerings. This is a new-business role. You will build your own pipeline, run complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first conversation to signature, and land accounts that grow with us as they add capabilities.

Our buyers fall into two groups. The first are firms launching a new exchange or brokerage and looking for the platform to build it on. The second, and larger, are firms that already have an established base of end users or assets and want to give those users access to digital assets: investment platforms and online brokers, asset managers and trading firms, private wealth and RIA platforms, fintechs adding crypto to an existing product, and the retirement channel, where brokers and IRA providers are bringing bitcoin ETFs and spot crypto to retirement accounts.

This is a builder role for someone with deep domain knowledge. You know how a broker-dealer, an asset manager, or a wealth platform actually works, what they need from a technology partner to launch digital assets, and who inside the building signs off on it. You can hold a first meeting with a CEO and a working session with a head of trading or a CTO in the same day, and you can teach a market what it should be asking for.

What You Will Do

  • Own new-business revenue for the AlphaPoint platform in your territory, selling APEX and APEX Treasury as an integrated platform rather than as standalone products, and consistently meet or exceed quota.
  • Build pipeline from scratch through your own network, targeted outbound, referral and partner channels, industry events, and content, with disciplined territory and account planning behind it.
  • Lead complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, product, technology, compliance, and legal, from discovery and solution design through commercial negotiation and contract close.
  • Develop and execute go-to-market plays for each target segment: investment platforms and brokers, asset managers and trading firms, private wealth, fintechs entering crypto, and retirement and IRA providers.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to prospects on how to structure a digital asset offering: which capabilities to launch first, how to integrate with existing systems and custodians, and how to stay within the regulatory perimeter in each market.
  • Partner with Solutions Engineers, Product, and Engineering to scope integrations and pilots, and bring structured market and client feedback back into the roadmap.
  • Work with Marketing on segment-specific campaigns, case studies, and events, and represent AlphaPoint at industry conferences and forums to build visibility and credibility in your markets.
  • Maintain an accurate, well-qualified pipeline and forecast in HubSpot, with clear next steps and close plans on every opportunity, and report weekly on pipeline health and progress to target.
  • Resourceful and hands-on: finds a way to move a deal forward regardless of the tools or processes in place, and helps build the playbooks the rest of the team will use.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise or institutional sales experience in capital markets technology, fintech, and digital asset infrastructure, with a track record of closing six-figure, multi-year contracts and consistently achieving quota.
  • Deep domain knowledge of at least two of our target segments: online brokerage and investment platforms, asset management and institutional trading, private wealth and RIA platforms, fintech, or the retirement and IRA channel. You understand how these firms are structured, how they make money, and how they buy technology.
  • Working knowledge of the digital asset ecosystem, including trading and execution, qualified custody, stablecoins and settlement, and the regulatory considerations that shape how regulated firms approach crypto.
  • Proven ability to build pipeline independently. You have opened new accounts and new segments before, not only worked inbound or an installed base.
  • An established network among decision-makers at financial institutions, brokers, wealth platforms, fintechs, or custodians, and a demonstrated ability to turn that network into qualified opportunities.
  • Technical fluency to engage credibly with CTOs, heads of trading, and product leaders on integration, APIs, and platform architecture, and to translate that into business outcomes for the C-suite.
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills across complex, multi-stakeholder deal structures, including partner-dependent deals where a custodian or liquidity provider is part of the solution.
  • Experience navigating regulated environments and a commitment to the highest ethical and compliance standards.
  • A data-driven approach to managing your business: rigorous CRM hygiene, accurate forecasting, and comfort using analytics and AI tools to prioritize and work your territory.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the presence to present to executive audiences and the clarity to write a proposal a CFO will read.

Preferred

  • Experience selling trading, custody, or market infrastructure technology to broker-dealers, asset managers, or wealth platforms (for example, OMS/EMS, execution, clearing, or custody connectivity).
  • Existing relationships with qualified custodians, ETF issuers or distributors, IRA and retirement-account providers, or crypto-native liquidity providers.
  • Experience in a venture-backed or growth-stage fintech where you helped define the sales motion rather than inherit it.
  • Familiarity with white-label and API-first platform models and the economics of platform partnerships.

How We Work

You will report to the VP of Sales and work closely with the commercial, product, and solutions teams. We value people who are direct, curious about how our clients’ businesses actually run, and generous with what they learn. We move quickly, own our outcomes, and treat every client as a long-term partner rather than a transaction.

🌎 About Us

At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “100 Best Remote-First Places to Work."
TeamSnap is looking for a Senior Product Designer who will craft experiences that connect parents, coaches and players to make youth sports more fun. You will partner closely with product and engineer partners to drive features from discovery through execution. You’ll play a key role in establishing consistency, ease of use and innovation across TeamSnap consumer experiences.

What You'll Do:

  • Design high-impact, consistent, and intuitive user experiences across platforms, considering market trends, customer feedback, and quantitative data.
  • Conduct user research and leverage insights to define product requirements, using sketches, wireframes, and prototypes to guide the ideation process.
  • Use a data-driven approach to tie design decisions to user research while balancing business goals and technical constraints.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers to refine requirements, validate designs, and iterate based on feedback.
  • Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, maintaining a sense of urgency while delivering high-quality designs.
  • Shape, improve, and maintain the TeamSnap design system.
  • Partner with marketing designers to ensure brand consistency across all digital products.

What Will Set You Up for Success:

  • Degree in design, human-computer interaction (HCI), or equivalent.
  • Experience in web and app development. Bonus points if you have experience with both B2B and B2C software.
  • An online portfolio that demonstrates the ability to turn high-level ideas and vision into a strong and unique UX and creative solutions with the success metrics to prove it.
  • Expertise in using Figma and prototyping tools.
  • Experience working in tight collaboration and influencing product, engineering, and marketing teams, with the ability to synthesize feedback and input from peers and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand and discuss technical concepts and cost/benefit tradeoffs of different design solutions.
Got cold feet? If you’re thinking you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here.

We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $145,000, inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.

TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you need to be very comfortable working with people who aren’t in the same time zone as you. We are always expanding, but there is a small list of states we do not hire in, including Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota West Virginia and Utah and while we love all parts of the world, we can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

raw.excerpt: About GAINSGAINS is on a mission to make supply chains smarter, faster, and self-improving, powered by AI.
raw.description:
About GAINS

GAINS is on a mission to make supply chains smarter, faster, and self-improving, powered by AI. Our Decision Engineering & Orchestration (DEO) platform does not just support decisions, it drives them by aligning strategy, planning, and execution across every level of the supply chain. We serve inventory-intensive industries where the stakes are high and the complexity is real, helping customers move from reactive, spreadsheet-driven planning to continuously learning, AI-led operations that deliver measurable results fast. At GAINS, we call it Moving Forward Faster, and it is not a tagline, it is how we are redefining what is possible in supply chain decision-making.

Summary

As a Project Manager, Supply Chain Design, you will lead the day-to-day execution of supply chain optimization projects for our clients. You will build the model structure in Supply Chain Architect, translate client network and historical data into model inputs, and manage the project from kickoff through delivery. This role requires hands-on supply chain project experience, strong analytical skills, and the ability to communicate outputs and cost/benefit impacts directly to client leadership.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Project Leadership
  • Lead and manage supply chain optimization projects from initiation to completion, ensuring on-time delivery and alignment with client expectations.
  • Own the day-to-day project plan, milestones, risks, and issue resolution.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to keep workstreams on schedule and dependencies visible.
Model Building in Supply Chain Architect
  • Build and maintain the model structure in Supply Chain Architect for each engagement.
  • Translate client network and historical data into validated model inputs.
  • Run scenarios and simulations across network design, inventory, and distribution strategies.
  • Test model assumptions with the client and document how inputs map to outputs.
Data Analysis
  • Analyze existing supply chain processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas for improvement.
  • Validate data quality and resolve gaps or inconsistencies in client-provided data sets.
  • Quantify cost and service impacts of proposed changes.
Supply Chain Mapping
  • Work with clients to understand their existing supply chain structure.
  • Develop supply chain maps that identify key touchpoints and potential bottlenecks.
Client Collaboration
  • Work directly with clients as the primary day-to-day project contact.
  • Communicate recommendations, model outputs, and cost/benefit impacts to client leadership.
  • Explain complex modeling concepts clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Build strong client relationships and manage expectations throughout the engagement.
Documentation and Reporting
  • Prepare reports documenting analysis, recommendations, and implementation plans.
  • Maintain accurate, organized, and accessible project documentation.
  • Deliver status updates and readouts on a consistent cadence.
Continuous Improvement
  • Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in supply chain design.
  • Contribute to the improvement of project methodologies, tools, and delivery processes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • Approximately 5 years of hands-on supply chain project experience, including running supply chain optimization projects.
  • Proficiency with supply chain modeling tools, simulation software, and data analytics.
  • Strong project management skills, including planning, scheduling, and risk management.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience presenting to leadership.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team and independently when required.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with supply chain software and technology solutions.
  • Experience building network optimization or simulation models in a commercial modeling tool.
  • Knowledge of sustainability practices in supply chain design.
  • Certification in supply chain management, logistics, or project management (for example, CSCMP, APICS, PMP).
  • Consulting or client-facing delivery experience across diverse industries.

raw.description:
Turner & Townsend is looking for a Specifications Writer, that will serve as the technical authority defining how our EV Clients physical infrastructure is built, maintained, and scaled globally.

The Design Studio builds and governs the physical footprint of our global network of facilities. Sitting at the intersection of architecture, engineering, and procurement, our mission is to translate spatial concepts into high-performance material standards. As a Specifications Writer, you will actively collaborate with Design, Governance, BIM, and Engineering teams to research material performance, close standards gaps, and craft buildable, legally sound, and cohesive technical specifications.

Responsibilities:

  • Draft & Evolve Master Specifications: Write, review, and continuously refine technical specification sections (Divisions 01 through 48) to support our evolving design standards and R&D requirements.
  • Drive Cross-Disciplinary Alignment: Partner closely with mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, and civil engineers to ensure engineering specifications seamlessly integrate with architectural materials and spatial requirements.
  • Identify & Bridge Standards Gaps: Proactively audit active design standards, identify missing specification sections, and independently research and develop new standards from scratch.
  • Lead Technical & Material Due Diligence: Research and vet proposed products, finishes, and equipment against durability, cost, sustainability targets, and building codes (IBC, NFPA, ADA, ASTM, ANSI, UL).
  • Establish Quality Control Guidelines: Create standardized checklists and review tools to help project managers evaluate external Architect of Record (AOR) CD submittals for brand and technical compliance.
  • Maintain Specification Databases: Own and curate the studio's MasterSpec/SpecLink cloud database, keeping templates up to date and readily accessible for production teams.
  • Integrate Real-World Insights: Partner with construction and operations teams to incorporate field "lessons learned" back into master specifications, preventing recurring field failures.
  • SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

Required Experience:

  • Experience: 5–8+ years in technical specifications writing, architectural production, or A/E contract documents delivery (or equivalent technical expertise).
  • Cross-Disciplinary Comfort: Demonstrated ability drafting and editing both architectural and engineering (MEP/Structural) specifications for cohesive delivery.
  • Industry Frameworks: Solid understanding of CSI MasterFormat, UniFormat, and SectionFormat structures as applied to corporate facility rollouts.
  • Specification Software: Proficiency with industry-standard tools such as BSD SpecLink or MasterSpec.
  • Technical Research & Code Mastery: Experience evaluating material data sheets, testing standards (ASTM, ANSI, UL), and building codes (IBC, NFPA, ADA).
  • Clear Technical Communication: Strong writing and editing skills with the ability to translate complex engineering concepts into concise, enforceable standards.
  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Civil/Mechanical Engineering, Construction Management, or equivalent technical training/experience.

Preferred Experience:

  • CSI Credentials: Certified Construction Specifier (CCS), Construction Documents Technologist (CDT), or Certified Construction Contract Administrator (CCCA).
  • Industry Engagement: Active membership in SCIP (Specifications Consultants in Independent Practice) or similar organizations.
  • Specialized Facility Experience: Background writing specifications for large-scale rollout programs, industrial spaces, R&D labs, EV charging infrastructure, or technical prototyping facilities.
  • BIM Integration: Familiarity with aligning Revit model metadata (shared parameters, keynotes) with specification databases to enable automated "BIM-to-Spec" workflows.
  • Sustainability Standards: Familiarity with sustainable building certifications (LEED, WELL) and green material specifications.

raw.description:
About The Greenwood Project
At Greenwood Project, we open doors in financial services for undergraduate freshmen. We give our scholars three things: social capital, the network that comes from knowing people inside the industry. Academic and technical capital, the training the work actually requires. And aspirational capital, the belief that the seat belongs to you.
This is not a workshop series. Scholars commit to twelve months of training, deliver real work on real deadlines, and finish knowing whether this industry is for them. Many go on to internships and full time offers at our partner firms. All of them leave with a network they did not have before.
The Sales & Relationship Academy
This academy trains institutional sales and relationship management. We want to be straight with you about that before you apply. Over twelve months you will learn how financial products work, how to explain them to someone deciding whether to move millions of dollars, and how to build a relationship that outlasts a single transaction.
The training travels further than almost anything else we teach. The ability to prepare, listen, pitch, and hold a room is what every commercial role hires for. But the programming is built around selling to and servicing institutional clients, and that is the work you should want.
What this academy trains
  • Institutional sales. Selling investment products and ideas to large organizations such as pension funds, asset managers, and corporations, rather than to individual consumers. The twelve months are built around this.
  • Relationship management and client coverage. Owning the ongoing relationship with a client, understanding their business, and being the person they call first.
Where that training can take you
  • Capital markets sales. Working with clients on stock and bond issuance, hedging, and market access.
  • Wealth management and private client. Advising individuals and families on how their money is invested. This is the largest employer of client facing talent in the industry and a common first seat.
  • Client service and business development. Supporting existing relationships and opening new ones.
Read that split carefully. The first two are what we teach. The rest are real places scholars land, and this training is the right foundation for them. But if you want a client facing job without learning the products underneath it, this is the wrong academy.

Program Overview
We are recruiting 100 scholars into the Sales & Relationship Academy for the 2029 cohort. Across all three Greenwood academies we will select 325.
You are eligible if you are currently a freshman graduating in 2030. We call this the 2029 cohort because Summer 2029 is the internship you are working toward.
When What happens
  • October 2026 to June 2027 Rolling admissions. Decisions every month. November is the priority round.
  • July 2027 Academy begins.
  • July 2027 to June 2028 Twelve months of training, from the summer after freshman year through your sophomore year.
  • Fall 2028 Junior year internship recruiting season. Greenwood supports you through interviews.
  • Summer 2029 The goal: a 10 week internship with a partner firm, the summer after your junior year.
  • Spring 2030 You graduate.

How rolling admissions works
We review applications and make decisions every month from October 2026 through June 2027. You will hear back within 4 weeks of the round your application lands in. Seats fill as we go, so the earliest rounds have the most of them open. Apply early.
You get one application
You submit one application for this cohort. Not one per academy, and not one per round. Our Talent & Recruitment team may move you to a different academy than the one you selected if your answers point somewhere else, so you do not need to get that choice perfect.
Every application gets one of three outcomes:
  • Accepted. You are in.
  • Deferred. We want to see more before we decide, usually your next term of grades. Your application carries forward automatically and you do not need to submit anything new. You will hear from us about two weeks before the next round of decisions, and again every month until we decide. You will not sit in silence.
  • Declined. Final for this cycle. Because this program only admits freshmen, we cannot reconsider you in a later round.
Deferral is the reason you can apply in an early round without taking a risk. If we are not ready to decide, we hold your application. We will not turn you away for applying before your first semester was finished.
Deadlines in this process are real. Once you apply, we will ask you for things on a schedule: transcripts, forms, sometimes an interview time. If you miss those deadlines, your application is declined rather than delayed. We hold this line because the program itself runs on deadlines, and how you handle ours tells us how you will handle those.
Please read this carefully. Internship placements are not guaranteed. Greenwood trains you, advocates for you, and puts you in front of our partner firms. Those firms make their own hiring decisions. What we guarantee is the preparation, the network, and honest feedback. The offer is something you earn.
What You'll Do
  • Build and deliver client presentations and pitches, then get critiqued on them in front of your peers. Repeatedly, until it stops being frightening.
  • Run relationship management simulations, including the uncomfortable ones: a client who is unhappy, a client who says no, a client who knows more than you do.
  • Learn what you are actually selling. Training on capital markets products, meaning the stocks, bonds, and other instruments companies and investors use, and on what moves their prices.
  • Learn to read a client. Active listening, asking the question behind the question, and figuring out what someone needs when they have not said it clearly.
  • Work with a mentor who does this for a living, and meet professionals at our partner firms.
  • Practice getting told no. Resilience in this job is a technical skill and we treat it like one.
Building AI Fluency
The client facing side of financial services is being rebuilt around AI, though not in the way people fear. Trust is still built between two people. What changed is everything surrounding that conversation. AI assistants built into CRM systems now summarize calls, draft follow ups, update records, and flag which client to contact next. CRM stands for customer relationship management, the system every firm uses to track client relationships. Salespeople who use these tools well spend their time in front of clients. The ones who do not spend it on admin, and it shows in their numbers.
Hands on with real tools. You will not just learn concepts. You will build working skill with the software and AI tools used on the job. Each Greenwood academy trains a different technical toolset, chosen to match the roles that academy actually feeds, so what you build here is specific to client research, pitch development, and relationship management rather than a general overview of finance technology.
What AI cannot do for you: earn a client's trust, read a room, or hold your nerve in a negotiation. Those are the reasons this job still belongs to people, and they are what we will push you on hardest.

What We're Looking For - Ideal Degree Backgrounds

Your major does not decide which academy fits you. Your interest does. Plenty of freshmen have not declared yet, and some schools do not allow it until sophomore year. Neither works against you. Major titles also vary from school to school, so if yours is named differently but covers the same ground, it counts. Tell us what it is called where you are.
Fields of study that line up with this academy
  • Finance
  • Business Administration, Management, or General Business
  • Communications
  • Economics
  • Political Science or Public Policy
  • Psychology or Sociology
  • Any major, if you can communicate well and are willing to learn the products
If you have not declared a major yet
You can apply as undeclared. What we need to see is that you are seriously pointed toward client facing work in financial services, meaning roles where the relationship is the job. Undeclared is not a weaker application. An undeclared student who can show us the following is stronger than a declared student who cannot.
  • Courses you have taken or registered for next term, such as economics, business, communications, or public speaking
  • Clubs and activities that back it up: a sales or pitch competition, debate, student government, a campus job in customer service, or anything where you have had to persuade someone
  • Anything you have taught yourself about markets or financial products
  • A clear answer to why this academy and not the Investment Banking or Fintech Academy
If your major is not on this list
This academy is the most major agnostic of the three, so almost nobody should be ruled out by field of study. What matters is whether you can hold a conversation, handle rejection, and put in the work to learn markets.

Technical skills you will build
You are not expected to arrive with any of these. You are expected to want them.
  • Market awareness, meaning the ability to speak credibly about what is happening in markets and why it matters to a client
  • A working understanding of capital markets and financial instruments, including stocks, bonds, and derivatives at a conceptual level
  • Presentation development and delivery, including the storytelling that makes a deck land
  • CRM systems and disciplined relationship tracking
  • Enough financial analysis to hold your own in a client conversation about numbers
  • Client and market research, so you walk in already knowing their business
  • Working with AI tools for research, drafting, and call follow up
Soft skills and characteristics
Greenwood selects scholars who show grit, resourcefulness, and intellectual curiosity, along with:
  • Strong verbal and written communication
  • Natural relationship building instincts and comfort with people you do not know
  • Confidence in client facing situations and in front of a room
  • Active listening, and the ability to hear what a client actually needs
  • Persuasive communication and early negotiation instincts
  • Resilience. You will be told no more often than yes, and it cannot change how you show up.
  • Adaptability and quick thinking when a conversation goes somewhere you did not plan for

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

What Makes a Strong Sales Academy Candidate:
The strongest candidates genuinely like people and are willing to be told no. That combination is rarer than it sounds. Being outgoing is not the qualification. Plenty of excellent salespeople are quiet. What matters is preparation, listening, and follow through.
What this takes
  • Twelve months, from the summer after freshman year through your sophomore year, on top of a full course load.
  • Roughly 6 to 8 hours per week, with heavier weeks around pitch deadlines.
  • Presenting in front of your peers and industry professionals, and being critiqued directly.
  • Managing your class schedule around program commitments and staying organized without being chased.
Eligibility Requirements
  • Currently enrolled as a freshman (Class of 2030) at an accredited four year institution
  • Minimum 3.2 GPA for standard consideration
  • Students with a GPA between 3.0 and 3.19 may apply with a required personal essay
  • Students below a 3.0 GPA are not eligible for this cycle
  • Your high school transcript, submitted with your application
  • Your first semester or first quarter college transcript, submitted with your application or as soon as grades post if you apply in an early round
  • A demonstrated commitment to excellence, integrity, character, and collaboration
If your GPA falls between 3.0 and 3.19, the essay is not a formality. Tell us what the number does not capture, and be specific about what you changed.
If you apply in an early round before you have a college GPA, we review your high school record first and confirm eligibility once your first term transcript arrives.

What You'll Gain

  • Communication skills that transfer anywhere. The ability to pitch, present, and hold a room is useful in every job you will ever have, including the ones outside finance.
  • Product knowledge. You will understand what you are selling, which separates a credible young salesperson from a scripted one.
  • AI capability most candidates do not have. Working AI tools into client research, outreach, and call follow up is exactly what sales desks are hiring for right now.
  • A real network. One on one coaching, a mentor in the industry, and access to professionals at our partner firms.
  • Resilience you can point to. You will have been told no, in practice, before it happens with a real client and a real number attached.
