Why You Should Apply

If you’re passionate and skilled but don’t meet every qualification, please apply anyway. Talent, potential, and enthusiasm are highly valued here.

B12 is a safe and inclusive workplace, welcoming applicants from diverse backgrounds. We particularly encourage applications from women, people of color, underrepresented minorities, and members of the LGBTQIA community.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and LinkedIn profile. Feel free to include a brief note introducing yourself and why you’re interested in joining B12.

About Us

Our mission is to empower people to do meaningful work. B12’s AI-powered website builder has been used by over a million businesses and allows users to create a professional website in seconds. Our platform also provides tools for scheduling, payments, and email marketing. We’re a fully remote company, founded in 2015, and supported by investors like Breyer Capital, General Catalyst, SV Angel, and Tola Capital. Visit to learn more.

AllenComm needs contractor support for six virtual Sylvamo workshops/focus groups with participants in Brazil. The contractor will provide Portuguese-language facilitation support and structured documentation so the internal AllenComm team can focus on synthesis, analysis, and downstream design work. The contractor will support workshop facilitation, capture detailed notes, coordinate recordings/transcripts, and organize documentation for upload into the project repository.

Required Skills/Qualifications: Fluent in Portuguese and English; experience facilitating or supporting virtual focus groups, interviews, workshops, or discovery sessions; strong note-taking and documentation skills; ability to translate or summarize Portuguese participant input clearly in English; comfort with virtual meeting tools and recordings; ability to organize detailed qualitative input without producing a separate findings or themes report; strong attention to detail; availability between mid-September and end of October 2026.

Preferred Skills/Qualifications: Experience supporting learning and development, training, instructional design, or change-management projects; experience with corporate stakeholders in Brazil; familiarity with structured interview documentation or stakeholder discovery; comfort working from English source materials and capturing participant input in English.

  • High Proficiency with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Salesforce Service Cloud, Pardot, and automation best practices, etc
  • Understand attribution, funnel stages, campaign tagging, and lifecycle tracking
  • High Proficiency with Google Suite and Microsoft Office.
  • Know how to translate business questions into dashboards, workflows, or logic flows
  • Have a passion for marketing strategy and want to scale the impact of the whole team
  • Are a proactive problem-solver with strong communication skills
  • Initiate and build relationships with people in an open, friendly, and accepting manner
  • Have a result and success-oriented mentality, conveying a sense of urgency and driving issues to closure
  • Note: This is a technical role, focused on data, reporting, and team enablement - not a leadership role

What’s in it for you...

  • Stock options in a profitable, fast-growing company
  • Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Company laptop (MacBook Pro) and branded swag
  • Weekly catered lunches and fully stocked snacks (if in-office)
  • A seat at the table: your work will have a direct, visible impact
  • A chance to join a team that genuinely values innovation, ownership, and growth

More about us - Promenade

Promenade is a mission-driven company empowering local businesses with products and services that allow them to thrive online and offline. We build vertically-focused software catered to each industry we serve, leveling the playing field between the small business and large aggregators. Promenade was originally founded in 2011 as BloomNation, the nation’s premier network for local florists, disrupting the multi-billion dollar floral industry. After helping thousands of local florists across the country, we doubled down on our mission and began helping more small businesses who carried the same challenges of acquiring and retaining their own customers. Today, Promenade creates software for four industries - BloomNation (Floral), Promenade (Food, Liquor and Butchers) . The company is based in Santa Monica, CA along with Remote roles.

Additional highlights…

Backed by premier industry investors such as Andreessen Horowitz (AirBnB, Box, Facebook, Lyft, Twitter, etc.), Spark Capital (Tumblr, Upworthy, Warby Parker, etc.), and Crunch Fund (Square, Uber, etc.)
Named one of Entrepreneur’s “5 Sizzling Silicon Beach Startups to Watch”
Located one block away from the beach on the world-famous 3rd Street Promenade in Santa Monica

Why join Promenade?

If you want a front-row seat in seeing a company disrupt a massive industry and you love the idea of helping hardworking business owners that serve our local communities and neighborhoods, this is your place. At Promenade, everyone has a voice to create change and move the needle. No hierarchy, no bureaucracy, no politics...just real people working on solving real problems.

Cloud Networking Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Cloud Networking Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are looking for a Cloud Networking Engineer to design, deploy, and operate service mesh platforms — primarily Istio and Linkerd — that provide secure, observable, and reliable service-to-service communication across our Kubernetes estate. The role focuses on platform engineering, mesh adoption, mTLS, traffic policy, and helping application teams reap the benefits of a mesh without paying for unnecessary complexity. The ideal candidate has operated service mesh in production, deeply understands Envoy and the data plane, and brings both platform engineering discipline and pragmatic adoption strategies.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Five or more years of experience in platform engineering, SRE, or networking roles.
  • Hands-on experience operating Istio or Linkerd in production.
  • Strong understanding of Envoy proxy internals and configuration.
  • Deep Kubernetes expertise including networking, CNI, and ingress.
  • Strong understanding of mTLS, PKI, and certificate lifecycle management.
  • Experience with distributed tracing and observability for mesh traffic.
  • Proficiency in Go or Python for tooling and automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across networking, application, and control plane layers.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with multi-cluster Istio or Linkerd deployments.
  • Familiarity with Cilium service mesh and eBPF networking.
  • Open-source contributions to service mesh projects.
  • Experience with SPIFFE/SPIRE for workload identity.
  • Exposure to zero-trust networking initiatives at enterprise scale.

raw.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

The Head of Consumer Product Marketing & Strategy is responsible for driving market share, product adoption, and mindshare for Empower’s consumer products and services, including its flagship offering, Personal Strategy®. This leader drives go-to-market strategy and product marketing for Empower Personal Wealth, a division focused on providing financial planning, investment management, and brokerage solutions to Empower retirement plan participants and consumers across the United States.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the overall product marketing strategy for Empower Personal Wealth, including product positioning, messaging, value propositions, customer segmentation, and go-to-market strategy.

  • Lead go-to-market planning and execution for the company’s portfolio of consumer financial products and services, including product packaging, bundling, merchandising, launches, and commercialization.

  • Develop strategic consumer-facing narratives that communicate Empower’s continuum of products and services across customers’ financial journeys, from their first job through retirement.

  • Integrate Empower’s brand positioning and value proposition consistently across consumer products, services, experiences, and touchpoints.

  • Develop phased go-to-market and product launch strategies for new and enhanced products and services, including pilot programs, audience expansion, general-market releases, and product-market-fit optimization.

  • Partner with Product, Sales, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and other business leaders to develop commercialization strategies and align product-development priorities.

  • Support portfolio rationalization and cost-benefit analysis for new and existing consumer products and services.

  • Define product performance measures and report product impact, adoption, market penetration, market share, asset growth, and new-account growth to executive leadership.

  • Partner with Product, Sales, Customer Experience, and Growth Marketing to develop customer engagement and retention strategies, including loyalty programs across customer asset tiers.

  • Develop and maintain consumer claims, proof points, and social proof supporting Empower’s consumer products and services.

  • Prioritize the annual consumer marketing campaign calendar based on strategic business narratives, product priorities, and customer needs.

  • Deliver competitive intelligence, external benchmarks, consumer financial trends, customer insights, and emerging-technology insights to inform product positioning and go-to-market strategies.

  • Own and continuously refine customer personas and segmentation strategies based on factors such as asset tiers and life stages.

  • Drive end-to-end consistency of Empower Personal Wealth’s value proposition to increase awareness, consideration, product adoption, and customer engagement.

  • Establish and track measurable commercial outcomes, including product adoption, market penetration, asset growth, and new-account growth.

  • Build, lead, develop, and transform a high-performing product marketing organization that influences priorities and coordinates effectively across senior leaders in Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations.

  • Evolve the product marketing function from primarily execution- and collateral-focused work toward strategic product marketing that strengthens market position, brand perception, commercialization, and customer understanding.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

  • 20+ years of marketing experience, including a demonstrated track record of successfully bringing consumer products and services to market.

  • Experience developing and executing product marketing, go-to-market, commercialization, product positioning, messaging, packaging, and product-market-fit strategies.

  • Advanced understanding of financial services, wealth management, investment products, financial planning, and brokerage solutions.

  • Demonstrated experience translating consumer behaviors, attitudes, and needs related to money, financial planning, investing, and wealth management into marketing and commercialization strategies.

  • Proven track record of driving measurable market-share growth and commercial outcomes.

  • Experience owning or influencing measurable commercial outcomes, including product adoption, market penetration, asset growth, and new account growth.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior leaders in a matrixed organization.

  • Strong expertise developing sales and marketing narratives and communicating complex product value propositions to consumer audiences.

  • Experience developing customer engagement, retention, or loyalty programs.

  • Experience using market research, competitive intelligence, customer insights, and segmentation to inform product marketing strategy.

  • Experience with customer personas and segmentation strategies.

  • Experience leading, managing, developing, and transforming product marketing teams, capabilities, and resources.

  • Knowledge of current marketing technologies, emerging marketing trends, and AI-enabled go-to-market practices.

  • Demonstrated experience applying artificial intelligence tools or capabilities within product marketing or go-to-market processes.

  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, cross-functional leadership, and influence skills.

What Will Set You Apart

  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree.

  • Direct professional experience in financial services, wealth management, investment management, retirement, brokerage, or related consumer financial products.

  • Experience leading product marketing within a large-scale consumer business or complex regulated environment.

  • Experience marketing financial products across multiple customer life stages, wealth tiers, or investment segments.

  • Experience launching and scaling new consumer financial products or digital wealth management offerings.

  • Experience developing AI-enabled product marketing, personalization, segmentation, customer insights, or go-to-market capabilities.

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year
  • Business-casual environment that includes the option to wear jeans
  • Generous paid time off upon hire – including a paid time off program plus ten paid company holidays and three floating holidays each calendar year
  • Paid volunteer time — 16 hours per calendar year
  • Leave of absence programs – including paid parental leave, paid short- and long-term disability, and Family and Medical Leave (FMLA)
  • Business Resource Groups (BRGs) – BRGs facilitate inclusion and collaboration across our business internally and throughout the communities where we live, work and play. BRGs are open to all.

Base Salary Range

$187,000.00 - $271,150.00

The salary range above shows the typical minimum to maximum base salary range for this position in the location listed. Non-sales positions have the opportunity to participate in a bonus program. Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. Actual compensation offered may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer.

Equal opportunity employer • Drug-free workplace

We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age (40 and over), race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

You must have reliable connectivity from an internet service provider that is fiber, cable or DSL internet. Other necessary computer equipment, will be provided. You may be required to work in the office if you do not have an adequate home work environment and the required internet connection.***

raw.description:
About CDI

The Constructive Dialogue Institute (CDI) is a non-partisan, non-profit dedicated to equipping the next generation of Americans with the skills to communicate and collaborate across lines of difference. We work with U.S. colleges and universities by providing co-curricular programming for students, professional development for faculty and staff, and strategic guidance to leadership. Our goal is to foster constructive dialogue at every level of the institution and to create the conditions for lasting organizational change. CDI was co-founded by psychologist Jonathan Haidt, the bestselling author of The Righteous Mind and The Anxious Generation.

About the Role

CDI is seeking a versatile, fast, and editorially sharp Communications & Content Manager to serve as the production engine behind our communications and thought leadership. Reporting to the VP of Strategic Communications, you will turn CDI's research and point of view into a steady stream of high-quality, on-message content that grows our audience and strengthens our reputation as a leading national voice on constructive dialogue in higher education.

This is a hands-on maker role. You will write and produce our higher education newsletter, blog, and social content; turn our flagship research into a full family of related pieces; and produce the materials that equip our Partnerships team to win new partnerships. You will support on keeping all the pieces of the shared editorial moving on a predictable cadence, coordinating closely with our subject-matter experts and Partnerships colleagues. You will also help build press relationships and contribute to CDI's media coverage, giving our VP of Strategic Communications added reach. You will partner closely with our Demand Generation lead, who runs the marketing funnel: you create the audience and the content, and they convert that attention into pipeline.

Responsibilities

Manage the editorial calendar and owned content

  • Write, build, and send CDI's higher education newsletter, and produce the blog, maintaining a reliable publishing cadence, growing our audience over time, and holding a high bar for quality, accuracy, and on-message voice.

  • Run a single, unified organic social calendar across brand, executive, and thought-leadership content, coordinating contributions from across the team to grow reach and engagement.

  • Collaborate with Partnerships and Marketing to align communications initiatives with other key workstreams such as webinars and conferences, tailor content for target segments, and sequence content for outsized pipeline impact.

Produce and repurpose thought leadership

  • Turn CDI's research (white papers, briefs, studies) into a full family of related content, blog posts, op-ed drafts, social posts, and newsletter features, maximizing the reach of each release.

  • Draft and package thought-leadership content while our subject-matter experts provide the underlying substance.

  • Coordinate production timelines with the Impact team and our subject-matter experts so content ships on time without overloading contributors.

Support earned media and track coverage

  • Help build and maintain CDI's press lists, draft pitches, and support the VP in securing media coverage.

  • Track and log CDI's media coverage and mentions, contributing to CDI's earned-media goals.

  • Build more direct media relationships over time, as your familiarity with CDI's work grows.

Produce marketing collateral and maintain brand standards

  • Produce audience-facing marketing collateral, directing external designers to a high standard and on deadline.

  • Maintain and steward CDI's brand templates and standards (set with the VP), and run the intake and triage process for design requests.

  • Produce marketing case studies and testimonials, partnering with the Demand Generation lead (who selects and secures permissions) and the Impact team (who supports research).

Requirements

About You

  • An experienced comms professional. You bring 5+ years in communications, content marketing, editorial, or journalism, ideally in a mission-driven, B2B, higher education, or advocacy context, with a portfolio of published work across formats (newsletters, articles or blogs, social, long-form).

  • A strong editorial operator (our top priority). You think in calendars, cadences, and systems, and you can keep many pieces of content moving at once without dropping quality or missing deadlines. You have thrived in a startup or scrappy environment, driving execution independently while building for scale.

  • An exceptional writer and editor. You produce clear, accurate, on-message content across many formats, and you do it fast, with a sharp editorial eye.

  • A sharp cross-functional collaborator. You work fluidly across subject-matter experts, marketing, and partnerships colleagues, and you keep work on track without constant direction.

  • Media-aware. You understand what makes a story newsworthy and are comfortable drafting pitches and building press relationships. Direct media experience is a plus.

  • Brand- and design-minded. You have a strong eye, can direct external designers, and can maintain templates and standards that keep a brand consistent. Canva experience a plus.

  • Politically astute and mission-aligned. You have the judgment to communicate constructively and credibly across ideological lines, you understand why nonpartisan restraint matters as much as visibility, and you are genuinely motivated by CDI's mission. Familiarity with the higher education landscape is a plus.

  • Fluent with tools, and with AI. You are comfortable with content and marketing tools (a CMS, an email platform such as HubSpot, social schedulers), and you use modern AI tools to accelerate drafting and production while treating human editing and judgment as non-negotiable, especially on sensitive topics.

Benefits

  • Compensation — $85,000-$95,000

  • A Mission-Driven Culture — our work culture genuinely reflects our mission, characterized by intellectual humility, continuous improvement, and open-mindedness

  • Remote-First — CDI was founded as a remote-first organization, and we work hard to maintain a strong team culture across vast distances

  • Unlimited PTO — as well as 13 company holidays

  • Remote Work Support — up to $500 reimbursed for home office equipment (like desks, chairs, or webcams) and up to $50/month reimbursed for home internet or cell phone expenses

  • Other Benefits — employer-supported health, vision and dental plans, subsidized parental leave, 3% 401k match, short- and long-term disability insurance, life and AD&D insurance, $1,000 annual professional development budget

Role Specs

  • Reports to: VP of Strategic Communications

  • Direct Reports: None

  • Schedule: Full-time, flexible within U.S. time zones

  • Target start date: October 12, 2026

  • Location: Remote, must be based in the U.S.

Highlights

CDI is seeking a Comms and Content Manager — an exceptional writer and operator to produce our newsletter, blog, and social content across higher ed.
